programme.title: 状王宋世杰 #22 [粤]
programme.desc: 拳脚二宗大战起来，乔从中挑拨，珑反当乔是好人，杰拾得二宗组宗之书。大、二比武，杰解说书中故事，当年两位祖师爷合力对抗劲敌，二人终和好如初。杰为求珑原谅，一闯五行无极阵，岂料被珑揭穿杰诡计，珑怒打杰。

programme.title: 状王宋世杰 #23 [粤]
programme.desc: 祖被册封为掌门，乔到来拉人，指天龙门犯上作乱，杰为自保，即称已被珑所休。大、二本欲归顺朝廷，格亲来审讯，乔急于铲除天龙门。杰苦思良策以替珑等洗脱罪名，杰往探监，见大、二使出天残地缺对付乔，杰突有灵感。

programme.title: 状王宋世杰 #24 [粤]
programme.desc: 杰上堂指出尔子孙繁多，足证未被大、二所伤，众被释放。星拼命储钱以迎娶燕，一日，燕被三调戏，星教训三，三扮身受重伤，星被拉上公堂，县官不分青红皂白，打星三十大板，星大受屈辱，珑决替星取回公道。

programme.title: 天与地 #6 [粤]
programme.desc: 卓桐约振轩全家和梓恩至迪士尼乐园，梓恩婉转表示与以朗早成过去。以朗派人偷拍咏仪与Ivan幽会照片。以朗替俊雄出气殴打Ivan，咏仪坦言俊雄为家明之死内疚。咏仪与俊雄共进晚饭后，收拾行李默然离去。

programme.title: 天与地 #7 [粤]
programme.desc: DJ Dylan离职，梓恩不舍；年少时咏仪不满俊雄沉迷乐队，提出分手，比赛成绩欠佳，以朗打算解散乐团，大家受家明热情感染重新振作；咏仪提出离婚，俊雄无言以对。卓桐在梓恩家喝醉，以朗不慎弄丢结婚戒指。

programme.title: 五味人生 #23 [粤]
programme.desc: 春见祯为贵逃走一事消沉不已，特意放下工作陪他到户外喝酒及安慰他。九决定独自回吴笃村，当他向扬告辞时，扬却鼓励他争取所爱。祯发现贵死去的消息，于是到义庄查看，妹从贵手中发现袖口钮……祯因无功而返在连家闷闷不乐之际，天竟带警察捉拿祯；春终看不过眼向天说他的真正身分。岚向扬询问有关遗书之事，扬指这样只是不忍祯为追查父亲之死耗费光阴。祯在街上公开指扬杀人，最终更与扬在街上争执。如冰得知祯与扬吵翻后竟要他离开，祯离开时春追出迫问他的心意；祯终哭著说出真相，却被九听到。

programme.title: 五味人生 #24 [粤]
programme.desc: 岚因为扬与祯起冲突之事再旧病复发变回少女模样，而因九离开，喜相逢又陷进了困境。扬向关家提出入股，而他将控制权交给九掌管，春爽快答应。天约见祯，指从金凤处得知祯目标是抢去扬资产，祯含冤受屈。春阻止祯对付扬时，之科通知祯说天遇上意外……天康复出院时，祯决定放弃追寻父亲之死的隐情。贵的首领大哥雄突然出现，更以贵之死要胁扬替他走私国宝。为了夺回「省港澳厨艺比试」的参赛权，祯用计接近主办的南天王；祯终于得知岚只是装傻以查探事实的真相。当众人欲登船前往香港作赛时，却突然有缉私队出现。

programme.title: 状王宋世杰 #22 [粤]
programme.desc: 拳脚二宗大战起来，乔从中挑拨，珑反当乔是好人，杰拾得二宗组宗之书。大、二比武，杰解说书中故事，当年两位祖师爷合力对抗劲敌，二人终和好如初。杰为求珑原谅，一闯五行无极阵，岂料被珑揭穿杰诡计，珑怒打杰。

programme.title: 状王宋世杰 #23 [粤]
programme.desc: 祖被册封为掌门，乔到来拉人，指天龙门犯上作乱，杰为自保，即称已被珑所休。大、二本欲归顺朝廷，格亲来审讯，乔急于铲除天龙门。杰苦思良策以替珑等洗脱罪名，杰往探监，见大、二使出天残地缺对付乔，杰突有灵感。

programme.title: 状王宋世杰 #24 [粤]
programme.desc: 杰上堂指出尔子孙繁多，足证未被大、二所伤，众被释放。星拼命储钱以迎娶燕，一日，燕被三调戏，星教训三，三扮身受重伤，星被拉上公堂，县官不分青红皂白，打星三十大板，星大受屈辱，珑决替星取回公道。

programme.title: 万凰之王 #19 [粤]
programme.desc: 成妃等人私下嘲静贵人与乐师两情相悦的事，未料一切被静贵人听见。静贵人当众罚成妃掌嘴，更指已获道光答应擢升为妃，她更向沅宛说将替她分担后宫工作，沅宛听后怒不可竭。小蔡子夜祭崔嬷嬷，但彩乔未完全烧毁的家书竟辗转到达道光的手中。道光质问静贵人，而她快将让道光相信自己时，沅宛突然带同证人前来揭发……绵忻于军营接报，得悉身患重病的太后被道光软禁，遂连忙返京代母求情，但道光只答应让他往探望太后。绵忻惊见沅宛怀孕多月，不断追问她是否怀有自己的孩儿；颐龄被指收贿贩卖鸦片而被打进天牢……

programme.title: 隔离七日情 #9 [粤]
programme.desc: 启富发现电话遗失，连忙找保安到来帮忙。少男把俊朗装进垃圾桶准备运走，却遇上找不到泳池的嘉嘉；少男发现出口已被上锁，欲致电向戴波报告，却发现内有肉参照片的手机不见了。早安调查启富时，认出其中一幅照片的人是当年诬陷父亲的人，遂肯定「比托尼亚星光」的失踪与启富有关。姚丹主动往找展龙求助，坦言急需钱，愿意为他再偷电话……少男为筹钱赎回手机，只好向玉芬借钱，却被仕灿阻止。俊辉不满可人与曼婷当众争执，遂出言教训她，未料可人以为吊得金龟婿竟辞职；可人竟沉醉在早安虚假的爱情圈套之中。

programme.title: 隔离七日情 #10 [粤]
programme.desc: 少男想尽办法也无法筹足五千元来赎回手机，几经辛苦才得知被嘉嘉玩弄，最后更错手击昏嘉嘉。早安查得启富与国强关系，故推断「比托尼亚星光」收藏在国强的办公室内；早安和贾瑜虽找到颈链但黄钻却不翼而飞。隔离第五天，福生对姚色迷，但她开出天价把福生吓走，福生只好再次向嘉嘉埋手，未料家燕与众阔太前往捉奸……早安与贾瑜得悉「比托尼亚星光」被人放在SPA的楼层时，却因突然被人撞破行动，而未有把黄钻取到手。仕灿把一本拳谱赠予唐晶，又向她传授拳术。展龙误中早安陷阱，被困在高温桑拿浴室内。

programme.title: 凤凰四重奏 #16 [粤]
programme.desc: 仁为争夺推广工作，与慕容超、广等商议，不惜用上不法手段。珍友钱智嫦与萍险堕骗徒陷阱，幸得仁友马虎之妻温婉柔出手相救。柔因打伤垃圾虫连累各人到警署，仁欲找马虎安排工作，与珍等人碰面。仁欲以李小龙形象作为广告重心，珍却以妇女角度为考量，起用萍和嫦两位真正主妇代替模特儿。虽广令裘被困电梯赶不及审议，但珍却不负众望，成功取得品牌推广工作。在珍的努力和创意下，日星品牌业务蒸蒸日上，仁等三人地位大不如前，反过来要提供协助，珍因碰面机会增加而担心会被揭穿真面目时，受卿启发心生一计。

programme.title: 凤凰四重奏 #17 [粤]
programme.desc: 仁在凤凰餐厅用膳时惊见一贵妇貌似卿，原来却是珍特意安排。及后在码头遇文受情变困扰，卿欲上前劝改，却因失足反将文推落海中。夫妻终因工事碰面，珍矢口否认，称只是人有相似，致电返家亦因卿和电话录音而未能求证。因早前在餐厅见过确有前车可鉴，仁虽有怀疑但亦不敢不信。珍接下来的工作正是帮助凤凰餐厅的推广工作，助文扭转乾坤。另一方面，仁为救小孩意外将文件扔失直接让生意告吹。珍与卿不幸被持枪要胁成为人质，最后虽有惊无险。但因仁从电视转播发现，赶到现场，终揭破真相，夫妻因此再起冲突。

programme.title: 毕打自己人 #79 [粤]
programme.desc: 殷赏答应为大学师妹余蕾的婚礼致祝贺词，众伴娘竟认为殷赏不应写贺词，殷赏一笑置之。余蕾看过殷赏的稿件后竟不停修改，殷赏感没趣。殷赏无意中发现余蕾的未婚夫廖震竟如别的女子一起；殷赏道出真相，廖震反指殷赏伤害两人的感情。《爆》周刊连续数期针对《潮》，闫器急召众人商讨对策，家升发现余蕾刚接任为《爆》的主编。翌日殷赏再被狗仔队跟踪，气得打鼓泄忿，幸汝大在旁支持，殷赏感动。网上流传廖震和女友争执的声带，还殷赏清白；同时，殷赏发现此事竟和Linda有关……

programme.title: 毕打自己人 #80 [粤]
programme.desc: 众《潮》人午膳时，乐儿发现廸高竟坐在家升的一旁；尧坚告知众人裁员传闻，众人不屑廸高的自保行为。廸高到诊所领取身体检查报告，医生竟建议他找来家人一起听结果，廸高证实患上非家族遗传的脑肿瘤。廸高请众男吃饭，众男难以置信。翌日廸高告知乐儿早前两人负责的广告佣金全数归她所有，又把几名大客户交予冰冰跟进，众人感意外。当廸高看到家升和殷赏开会，误会两商讨裁员细节，廸高竟往找闫器理论，闫器等未知如何反应，恼羞成怒反责廸高胆大妄为。廸高覆诊时，惊见警员押被缚的「医生」步出，始知真相……

programme.title: 毕打自己人 #81 [粤]
programme.desc: 《潮》人讨论《爆》周刊描述一对准备结婚的豪门情侣因纹身而分手之事，励军建议《潮》可开设名人纹身的专栏，宝拉笑指《爆》周刊已预告此乃下期的卖点。殷赏带同国仁出席好友Peter的国际记者奖项颁奖礼，发现Peter曾为丽薇做专访，更看到她的腰间有两个中文字的纹身；Peter不懂中文，忆述丽薇形容那是他重视的男性名字。休假中的丽薇以一身低腰运动服出席会议，汝大看著丽薇腰部，竟幻想其纹身是「汝大」两字。汝大向殷赏坦言担心丽薇的纹身，并告知当年丽薇向他示爱，两人有所盘算……

programme.title: 万凰之王 #19 [粤]
programme.desc: 成妃等人私下嘲静贵人与乐师两情相悦的事，未料一切被静贵人听见。静贵人当众罚成妃掌嘴，更指已获道光答应擢升为妃，她更向沅宛说将替她分担后宫工作，沅宛听后怒不可竭。小蔡子夜祭崔嬷嬷，但彩乔未完全烧毁的家书竟辗转到达道光的手中。道光质问静贵人，而她快将让道光相信自己时，沅宛突然带同证人前来揭发……绵忻于军营接报，得悉身患重病的太后被道光软禁，遂连忙返京代母求情，但道光只答应让他往探望太后。绵忻惊见沅宛怀孕多月，不断追问她是否怀有自己的孩儿；颐龄被指收贿贩卖鸦片而被打进天牢……

programme.title: 隔离七日情 #9 [粤]
programme.desc: 启富发现电话遗失，连忙找保安到来帮忙。少男把俊朗装进垃圾桶准备运走，却遇上找不到泳池的嘉嘉；少男发现出口已被上锁，欲致电向戴波报告，却发现内有肉参照片的手机不见了。早安调查启富时，认出其中一幅照片的人是当年诬陷父亲的人，遂肯定「比托尼亚星光」的失踪与启富有关。姚丹主动往找展龙求助，坦言急需钱，愿意为他再偷电话……少男为筹钱赎回手机，只好向玉芬借钱，却被仕灿阻止。俊辉不满可人与曼婷当众争执，遂出言教训她，未料可人以为吊得金龟婿竟辞职；可人竟沉醉在早安虚假的爱情圈套之中。

programme.title: 隔离七日情 #10 [粤]
programme.desc: 少男想尽办法也无法筹足五千元来赎回手机，几经辛苦才得知被嘉嘉玩弄，最后更错手击昏嘉嘉。早安查得启富与国强关系，故推断「比托尼亚星光」收藏在国强的办公室内；早安和贾瑜虽找到颈链但黄钻却不翼而飞。隔离第五天，福生对姚色迷，但她开出天价把福生吓走，福生只好再次向嘉嘉埋手，未料家燕与众阔太前往捉奸……早安与贾瑜得悉「比托尼亚星光」被人放在SPA的楼层时，却因突然被人撞破行动，而未有把黄钻取到手。仕灿把一本拳谱赠予唐晶，又向她传授拳术。展龙误中早安陷阱，被困在高温桑拿浴室内。

programme.title: 凤凰四重奏 #16 [粤]
programme.desc: 仁为争夺推广工作，与慕容超、广等商议，不惜用上不法手段。珍友钱智嫦与萍险堕骗徒陷阱，幸得仁友马虎之妻温婉柔出手相救。柔因打伤垃圾虫连累各人到警署，仁欲找马虎安排工作，与珍等人碰面。仁欲以李小龙形象作为广告重心，珍却以妇女角度为考量，起用萍和嫦两位真正主妇代替模特儿。虽广令裘被困电梯赶不及审议，但珍却不负众望，成功取得品牌推广工作。在珍的努力和创意下，日星品牌业务蒸蒸日上，仁等三人地位大不如前，反过来要提供协助，珍因碰面机会增加而担心会被揭穿真面目时，受卿启发心生一计。

programme.desc: 启富发现电话遗失，连忙找保安到来帮忙。少男把俊朗装进垃圾桶准备运走，却遇上找不到泳池的嘉嘉；少男发现出口已被上锁，欲致电向戴波报告，却发现内有肉参照片的手机不见了。早安调查启富时，认出其中一幅照片的人是当年诬陷父亲的人，遂肯定「比托尼亚星光」的失踪与启富有关。姚丹主动往找展龙求助，坦言急需钱，愿意为他再偷电话……少男为筹钱赎回手机，只好向玉芬借钱，却被仕灿阻止。俊辉不满可人与曼婷当众争执，遂出言教训她，未料可人以为吊得金龟婿竟辞职；可人竟沉醉在早安虚假的爱情圈套之中。

programme.title: 隔离七日情 #10 [粤]
programme.desc: 少男想尽办法也无法筹足五千元来赎回手机，几经辛苦才得知被嘉嘉玩弄，最后更错手击昏嘉嘉。早安查得启富与国强关系，故推断「比托尼亚星光」收藏在国强的办公室内；早安和贾瑜虽找到颈链但黄钻却不翼而飞。隔离第五天，福生对姚色迷，但她开出天价把福生吓走，福生只好再次向嘉嘉埋手，未料家燕与众阔太前往捉奸……早安与贾瑜得悉「比托尼亚星光」被人放在SPA的楼层时，却因突然被人撞破行动，而未有把黄钻取到手。仕灿把一本拳谱赠予唐晶，又向她传授拳术。展龙误中早安陷阱，被困在高温桑拿浴室内。

programme.title: 凤凰四重奏 #16 [粤]
programme.desc: 仁为争夺推广工作，与慕容超、广等商议，不惜用上不法手段。珍友钱智嫦与萍险堕骗徒陷阱，幸得仁友马虎之妻温婉柔出手相救。柔因打伤垃圾虫连累各人到警署，仁欲找马虎安排工作，与珍等人碰面。仁欲以李小龙形象作为广告重心，珍却以妇女角度为考量，起用萍和嫦两位真正主妇代替模特儿。虽广令裘被困电梯赶不及审议，但珍却不负众望，成功取得品牌推广工作。在珍的努力和创意下，日星品牌业务蒸蒸日上，仁等三人地位大不如前，反过来要提供协助，珍因碰面机会增加而担心会被揭穿真面目时，受卿启发心生一计。

programme.title: 凤凰四重奏 #17 [粤]
programme.desc: 仁在凤凰餐厅用膳时惊见一贵妇貌似卿，原来却是珍特意安排。及后在码头遇文受情变困扰，卿欲上前劝改，却因失足反将文推落海中。夫妻终因工事碰面，珍矢口否认，称只是人有相似，致电返家亦因卿和电话录音而未能求证。因早前在餐厅见过确有前车可鉴，仁虽有怀疑但亦不敢不信。珍接下来的工作正是帮助凤凰餐厅的推广工作，助文扭转乾坤。另一方面，仁为救小孩意外将文件扔失直接让生意告吹。珍与卿不幸被持枪要胁成为人质，最后虽有惊无险。但因仁从电视转播发现，赶到现场，终揭破真相，夫妻因此再起冲突。

programme.title: 毕打自己人 #80 [粤]
programme.desc: 众《潮》人午膳时，乐儿发现廸高竟坐在家升的一旁；尧坚告知众人裁员传闻，众人不屑廸高的自保行为。廸高到诊所领取身体检查报告，医生竟建议他找来家人一起听结果，廸高证实患上非家族遗传的脑肿瘤。廸高请众男吃饭，众男难以置信。翌日廸高告知乐儿早前两人负责的广告佣金全数归她所有，又把几名大客户交予冰冰跟进，众人感意外。当廸高看到家升和殷赏开会，误会两商讨裁员细节，廸高竟往找闫器理论，闫器等未知如何反应，恼羞成怒反责廸高胆大妄为。廸高覆诊时，惊见警员押被缚的「医生」步出，始知真相……

programme.title: 毕打自己人 #81 [粤]
programme.desc: 《潮》人讨论《爆》周刊描述一对准备结婚的豪门情侣因纹身而分手之事，励军建议《潮》可开设名人纹身的专栏，宝拉笑指《爆》周刊已预告此乃下期的卖点。殷赏带同国仁出席好友Peter的国际记者奖项颁奖礼，发现Peter曾为丽薇做专访，更看到她的腰间有两个中文字的纹身；Peter不懂中文，忆述丽薇形容那是他重视的男性名字。休假中的丽薇以一身低腰运动服出席会议，汝大看著丽薇腰部，竟幻想其纹身是「汝大」两字。汝大向殷赏坦言担心丽薇的纹身，并告知当年丽薇向他示爱，两人有所盘算……

programme.title: 万凰之王 #19 [粤]
programme.desc: 成妃等人私下嘲静贵人与乐师两情相悦的事，未料一切被静贵人听见。静贵人当众罚成妃掌嘴，更指已获道光答应擢升为妃，她更向沅宛说将替她分担后宫工作，沅宛听后怒不可竭。小蔡子夜祭崔嬷嬷，但彩乔未完全烧毁的家书竟辗转到达道光的手中。道光质问静贵人，而她快将让道光相信自己时，沅宛突然带同证人前来揭发……绵忻于军营接报，得悉身患重病的太后被道光软禁，遂连忙返京代母求情，但道光只答应让他往探望太后。绵忻惊见沅宛怀孕多月，不断追问她是否怀有自己的孩儿；颐龄被指收贿贩卖鸦片而被打进天牢……

programme.title: 万凰之王 #20 [粤]
programme.desc: 颐龄于狱中被神秘杀手伏击，幸得锷泰及时出手相救；道光不忍伊兰与锷泰再三请求，终答应听其自辩。沅宛暗中喝下重分量的催生药，务求比伊兰抢先诞下大阿哥。众妃嫔给伊兰送贺礼时，传来颐龄于狱中遭人劫走的消息。伊兰突然作动并平安诞下大阿哥，道光得悉喜讯的同时，却接到颐龄拒捕被杀的消息。沅宛回寝宫途中难忍腹痛，路过的绵忻见状连忙将她抱回去。沅宛顺利产子，宝宝却患上急病发热，道光闻言下令宫中上下斋戒祈福。沅宛回想一切，相信是上天给予她的惩罚，愿意折寿，求上天宽恕，顿觉没有事情比儿子重要……

programme.title: 隔离七日情 #11 [粤]
programme.desc: 展龙昏倒在桑拿浴室，幸得唐晶寻至，仕灿破门而入，才得以救回展龙一命。贾瑜对早安的做法感到不满，早安却反问贾瑜何以对展龙特别关心。仕灿向展龙透露自己是释囚，因得到启富与国强之助才能加入酒店；展龙决定与仕灿合作，仕灿提醒他与唐晶应提防早安。启富对早安表示对SPA层出意外一无所知，随后却约见俊辉在该层对话，使早安确定启富正是偷取黄钻之人，但原来仕灿亦目睹两人见面的过程……展龙与仕灿成功查得启富与俊辉合作的内容的同时，贾瑜亦发现早安拍下启富与俊辉的会面片段有异样。

programme.title: 隔离七日情 #12 [粤]
programme.desc: 俊朗在吃饭时浪费食物，嘉嘉出言灌输正确知识，少男发现眼前人犹如天使。国强交赎金时卓奇带同下属前往配合，布下天罗地网，未料中途被人偷龙转凤。仕灿向展龙及唐晶忆起少男行径，疑点重重，决定转往监视少男，未料他们的对话被嘉嘉听见，使计把众人骗走。早安要求贾瑜从公款中提取五百万，让他买下心爱的游艇，未料遭贾瑜婉拒，两人不欢而散。可人看见早安走进别人的客房偷钱；早安对自己是窃贼身分直认不讳，更请可人成为拍档。贾瑜发现可人的异样，遂使计了解，惊见她戴「比托尼亚星光」黄钻，大感错愕。

programme.title: 凤凰四重奏 #18 [粤]
programme.desc: 珍出走到卿家中暂住，仁将家弄至乌烟瘴气，但仁与珍再倾谈，珍答应处理手头工作后辞职。发布会空前成功，珍更备受赏识，但珍受好色客户骚扰，幸得裘及时解围。仁误会裘欲乘人之危，将他毒打一番。刘广夫妇在酒会上，意外遗失借来的宝石首饰，为坚拾得，在贪念下秘而不宣，不料原来只是假货以致空欢喜一场。嫦却误以为真品，竟以重金买下真货交还，教各人哭笑不得。红误以为仁公开其整容传闻，以早前遗失文件连累公司损失为理由将他辞退。仁不敢对珍说出真相而费煞思量，却因自视过高一直无法找到工作，苦不堪言。

programme.title: 凤凰四重奏 #19 [粤]
programme.desc: 仁终脱离失业生活，不料却成为珍下属。文欲东山再起，通宵达旦炮制推广计划，但计划书却在阴差阳错下落入裘手中。裘将计划书据为己有，令仁哑子吃黄莲有苦自己知。及后裘到电视台洽商，仁利用戏服掩饰毒打裘报复，却被裘认出。裘以不适为由，临时拉夫要仁充当综艺比赛主持，不料仁与珍合作无间，夫妇二人的完美演出更叫人眼前一亮，教存心想令其出丑的裘咬牙切齿。裘以义赠电器行善兼收宣传之效，与珍一同到长洲探望独居老人。裘在教导使用电器说明时，却借故播出经剪辑加工过的录音，令珍误会人为上位不择手段。

programme.title: 毕打自己人 #82 [粤]
programme.desc: 宝拉到天光墟为新专题搜集资料，却看到Herman向露宿者递上早餐闲聊，不禁拍下照片。Herman发现，坦言有当露宿者的经历，遂约定接受访问。宝拉遗失了Herman的联络，幸得励军寻回。励军看到Herman的照片，指宝拉暗恋Herman是因为其外型，宝拉不忿离去。励军跟随宝拉到天光墟，明白宝拉真心欣赏Herman的内涵，遂找机会向宝拉道歉，又鼓励她约会Herman。宝拉鼓起勇气约Herman午饭，宝拉到达时，却看到Herman在抽烟，不其然失望。

programme.title: 毕打自己人 #83 [粤]
programme.desc: 汝大匆匆赶至金波股东会议，道出闫器出席晚宴时不慎受伤送院。丽薇建议闫器聘请私人男助理，乘机提出可找公司律师兼任，并向闫器推荐Richard兼任，家升把一切看在眼内。Richard向丽薇报告当助理后知道的大小事项；Richard误以为闫器欲收购一楼宇发展，竟私下接触单位业主罗雪仙，并大幅压价。闫器得知后感气结，家升路过献上计策；闫器带家升见雪仙时，家升得体的表现令闫器非常满意。汝大和殷赏往找闫器，欲推荐Herman取代Richard。

programme.title: 毕打自己人 #84 [粤]
programme.desc: 闫器要求殷赏访问「妇女扶贫雅集」主席罗雪仙，也命令同和为他找一款已停产四十年的香水；汝大告知殷赏闫器寻香水原因。闫器命殷赏把雪仙留在《潮》，但殷赏接到消息指闫器发生意外，和雪仙赶到医院了解。原来闫器为了找回雪仙四十年前送的香水而横过马路，不慎扭伤，雪仙感动。另一方面，国仁等为博闫器欢心，竟根据汝大向殷赏提供的资料，将「俏郎君」香水的包装数码重组，加上同和收集了当年最流行的香水，沟成一支估计是「俏郎君」味道的香水，带往探望闫器。医院致电汝大，指闫器为约会雪仙偷偷离开……

programme.title: 万凰之王 #20 [粤]
programme.desc: 颐龄于狱中被神秘杀手伏击，幸得锷泰及时出手相救；道光不忍伊兰与锷泰再三请求，终答应听其自辩。沅宛暗中喝下重分量的催生药，务求比伊兰抢先诞下大阿哥。众妃嫔给伊兰送贺礼时，传来颐龄于狱中遭人劫走的消息。伊兰突然作动并平安诞下大阿哥，道光得悉喜讯的同时，却接到颐龄拒捕被杀的消息。沅宛回寝宫途中难忍腹痛，路过的绵忻见状连忙将她抱回去。沅宛顺利产子，宝宝却患上急病发热，道光闻言下令宫中上下斋戒祈福。沅宛回想一切，相信是上天给予她的惩罚，愿意折寿，求上天宽恕，顿觉没有事情比儿子重要……

programme.title: 凤凰四重奏 #18 [粤]
programme.desc: 珍出走到卿家中暂住，仁将家弄至乌烟瘴气，但仁与珍再倾谈，珍答应处理手头工作后辞职。发布会空前成功，珍更备受赏识，但珍受好色客户骚扰，幸得裘及时解围。仁误会裘欲乘人之危，将他毒打一番。刘广夫妇在酒会上，意外遗失借来的宝石首饰，为坚拾得，在贪念下秘而不宣，不料原来只是假货以致空欢喜一场。嫦却误以为真品，竟以重金买下真货交还，教各人哭笑不得。红误以为仁公开其整容传闻，以早前遗失文件连累公司损失为理由将他辞退。仁不敢对珍说出真相而费煞思量，却因自视过高一直无法找到工作，苦不堪言。

programme.title: 凤凰四重奏 #19 [粤]
programme.desc: 仁终脱离失业生活，不料却成为珍下属。文欲东山再起，通宵达旦炮制推广计划，但计划书却在阴差阳错下落入裘手中。裘将计划书据为己有，令仁哑子吃黄莲有苦自己知。及后裘到电视台洽商，仁利用戏服掩饰毒打裘报复，却被裘认出。裘以不适为由，临时拉夫要仁充当综艺比赛主持，不料仁与珍合作无间，夫妇二人的完美演出更叫人眼前一亮，教存心想令其出丑的裘咬牙切齿。裘以义赠电器行善兼收宣传之效，与珍一同到长洲探望独居老人。裘在教导使用电器说明时，却借故播出经剪辑加工过的录音，令珍误会人为上位不择手段。

programme.title: 毕打自己人 #82 [粤]
programme.desc: 宝拉到天光墟为新专题搜集资料，却看到Herman向露宿者递上早餐闲聊，不禁拍下照片。Herman发现，坦言有当露宿者的经历，遂约定接受访问。宝拉遗失了Herman的联络，幸得励军寻回。励军看到Herman的照片，指宝拉暗恋Herman是因为其外型，宝拉不忿离去。励军跟随宝拉到天光墟，明白宝拉真心欣赏Herman的内涵，遂找机会向宝拉道歉，又鼓励她约会Herman。宝拉鼓起勇气约Herman午饭，宝拉到达时，却看到Herman在抽烟，不其然失望。

programme.title: 毕打自己人 #83 [粤]
programme.desc: 汝大匆匆赶至金波股东会议，道出闫器出席晚宴时不慎受伤送院。丽薇建议闫器聘请私人男助理，乘机提出可找公司律师兼任，并向闫器推荐Richard兼任，家升把一切看在眼内。Richard向丽薇报告当助理后知道的大小事项；Richard误以为闫器欲收购一楼宇发展，竟私下接触单位业主罗雪仙，并大幅压价。闫器得知后感气结，家升路过献上计策；闫器带家升见雪仙时，家升得体的表现令闫器非常满意。汝大和殷赏往找闫器，欲推荐Herman取代Richard。

programme.title: 毕打自己人 #84 [粤]
programme.desc: 闫器要求殷赏访问「妇女扶贫雅集」主席罗雪仙，也命令同和为他找一款已停产四十年的香水；汝大告知殷赏闫器寻香水原因。闫器命殷赏把雪仙留在《潮》，但殷赏接到消息指闫器发生意外，和雪仙赶到医院了解。原来闫器为了找回雪仙四十年前送的香水而横过马路，不慎扭伤，雪仙感动。另一方面，国仁等为博闫器欢心，竟根据汝大向殷赏提供的资料，将「俏郎君」香水的包装数码重组，加上同和收集了当年最流行的香水，沟成一支估计是「俏郎君」味道的香水，带往探望闫器。医院致电汝大，指闫器为约会雪仙偷偷离开……

programme.title: 万凰之王 #20 [粤]
programme.desc: 颐龄于狱中被神秘杀手伏击，幸得锷泰及时出手相救；道光不忍伊兰与锷泰再三请求，终答应听其自辩。沅宛暗中喝下重分量的催生药，务求比伊兰抢先诞下大阿哥。众妃嫔给伊兰送贺礼时，传来颐龄于狱中遭人劫走的消息。伊兰突然作动并平安诞下大阿哥，道光得悉喜讯的同时，却接到颐龄拒捕被杀的消息。沅宛回寝宫途中难忍腹痛，路过的绵忻见状连忙将她抱回去。沅宛顺利产子，宝宝却患上急病发热，道光闻言下令宫中上下斋戒祈福。沅宛回想一切，相信是上天给予她的惩罚，愿意折寿，求上天宽恕，顿觉没有事情比儿子重要……

programme.title: 隔离七日情 #11 [粤]
programme.desc: 展龙昏倒在桑拿浴室，幸得唐晶寻至，仕灿破门而入，才得以救回展龙一命。贾瑜对早安的做法感到不满，早安却反问贾瑜何以对展龙特别关心。仕灿向展龙透露自己是释囚，因得到启富与国强之助才能加入酒店；展龙决定与仕灿合作，仕灿提醒他与唐晶应提防早安。启富对早安表示对SPA层出意外一无所知，随后却约见俊辉在该层对话，使早安确定启富正是偷取黄钻之人，但原来仕灿亦目睹两人见面的过程……展龙与仕灿成功查得启富与俊辉合作的内容的同时，贾瑜亦发现早安拍下启富与俊辉的会面片段有异样。

programme.desc: 展龙昏倒在桑拿浴室，幸得唐晶寻至，仕灿破门而入，才得以救回展龙一命。贾瑜对早安的做法感到不满，早安却反问贾瑜何以对展龙特别关心。仕灿向展龙透露自己是释囚，因得到启富与国强之助才能加入酒店；展龙决定与仕灿合作，仕灿提醒他与唐晶应提防早安。启富对早安表示对SPA层出意外一无所知，随后却约见俊辉在该层对话，使早安确定启富正是偷取黄钻之人，但原来仕灿亦目睹两人见面的过程……展龙与仕灿成功查得启富与俊辉合作的内容的同时，贾瑜亦发现早安拍下启富与俊辉的会面片段有异样。

programme.title: 隔离七日情 #12 [粤]
programme.desc: 俊朗在吃饭时浪费食物，嘉嘉出言灌输正确知识，少男发现眼前人犹如天使。国强交赎金时卓奇带同下属前往配合，布下天罗地网，未料中途被人偷龙转凤。仕灿向展龙及唐晶忆起少男行径，疑点重重，决定转往监视少男，未料他们的对话被嘉嘉听见，使计把众人骗走。早安要求贾瑜从公款中提取五百万，让他买下心爱的游艇，未料遭贾瑜婉拒，两人不欢而散。可人看见早安走进别人的客房偷钱；早安对自己是窃贼身分直认不讳，更请可人成为拍档。贾瑜发现可人的异样，遂使计了解，惊见她戴「比托尼亚星光」黄钻，大感错愕。

programme.title: 万凰之王 #21 [粤]
programme.desc: 伊兰冒风雪往拜祭颐龄，沅宛同样懒理风雪，把握机会到停堂替爱儿祈福。伊兰回宫时重遇沅宛，透露父亲惨死，更暗示大人的罪孽或会连累下一代。伊兰传召锷泰，将广东巡抚的恶行相告，道光惊悉有官员找来假冒洋人欺骗钦差大臣后，答应重审还颐龄公道。太后对道光冷待自己感心酸，卫公公内疚不已，自毁左目谢罪；太后决定重整旗鼓，替绵忻的将来铺路。太后消渴症日益严重，脚部受感染而溃疡，但她竟冒风雪三跪九叩为孙儿祈福；道光感动原谅太后。舒明阿打算除去锷泰，但却被沅宛阻止。皇后孩儿突然病发，命悬一线……

programme.title: 隔离七日情 #13 [粤]
programme.desc: 早安发现可人独自在天台酒吧喝得半醉，细问下才发现她因遗失了「家传之宝」而担心，早安失笑指那颗黄钻是膺品。唐晶不慎丢掉录音笔并遭嘉嘉拾到。在隔离第六日早上，众住客惊见报纸绘影绘声地歪曲报道酒店内的情况，写尽他们的丑态，情涌。家燕迫俊辉找到出卖住客的人，他指少男最大嫌疑，拉扯间少男身上竟跌出一支录音笔；展龙决定跟踪少男，但遭嘉嘉破坏。展龙到泳池散心，误会贾瑜出了意外，奋不顾身跳进泳池将她救起。国强来到酒店，表面是替员工和住客打气，实质是与仕灿里应外合调查俊朗的下落。

programme.title: 隔离七日情 #14 [粤]
programme.desc: 国强从仓库中找到俊朗的字条，大为紧张，相信儿子确实被绑匪困于酒店；展龙在后楼梯巧遇姚丹，有感她行为古怪而上前查问，被丹带往游花园。戴波得悉国强入住酒店，看穿他为查绑匪而来，遂安排少男制造混乱，让他潜入酒店；而展龙的母亲咏梅亦暗中混入酒店。少男制造小火欲烧毁曾禁锢俊朗的证据；意外地贾瑜被困火场，早安不顾一切进内相救。国强探望贾瑜等人，而重遇俊朗的护士长生母。咏梅喜见儿子，但遭展龙与唐晶发现她与仕灿的关系非比寻常。可人不满遭早安冷待而大发脾气，而质问他何以冲入火场救贾瑜。

programme.title: 凤凰四重奏 #20 [粤]
programme.desc: 在裘设计下珍与仁夫妻反目，另一边厢文借拜姻缘石之机，表白倾慕之情，不料却被卿拒绝。超因钱包被抢追入无上装酒吧，被红误会，纠缠间意外遭车撞伤送院。不料原来却是苦肉计，众男更结成「烂滚团」，趁红、珍等到日本公干寻花问柳。与此同时，坚与萍却被骗徒设局，被敲诈勒索逼跳艳舞，而且更与「烂滚团」狭路相逢，结果落得齐齐被敲竹杠赔上大笔金钱的下场。柔约同江湖老叔父为各人讨回公道，混乱中虎舍身救妻，幸有惊无险。红等提早返港，在酒店房中鬼混的各人险被撞破，但因留下蛛丝马迹，促成「缉私团」成立。

programme.title: 凤凰四重奏 #21 [粤]
programme.desc: 虎因受命调查跨国卖淫集团，于是加入以超为首的「烂滚团」到处风流。虽红布下陷阱，但因被发现而未能成功。虎被安排以失枪为由被停职，不料柔却到处张罗买枪以作解决，虽令人啼笑皆非，却让虎大为感动。卿与文意外发现汪子君与凤凰餐厅的渊源，珍决定大力推广，仁在裘设计下持相反意见，二人更是势成水火。而超等各人终与卖淫集团接触，众女亦得仁通风报信，杀上宾馆捉奸在床。超、坚等均被赶出家门，珍失望离开，各人于是借此机暂居仁家中。众女在网球场上与教练眉来眼去以作为报复，看得各人咬牙切齿。

programme.title: 毕打自己人 #85 [粤]
programme.desc: 素珊到服装店挑选新装，首富袁有成的太太看中刚被素珊批评得体无完肤的款式，素珊竟从店员手上抢回，表示她刚试完应有优先购买权；此时有成步入时装店，并表示会命人到巴黎总站订货，素珊感酸溜溜。迟来的素珊得知丽薇因未能约见一富豪而生气，夸口她可以约到。然而丽薇欲约见的竟是有成。素珊无法推搪，遂要求闫器著殷赏重新访问她一次。殷赏专访素珊，她道出一段鲜为人知的感情创伤，令殷赏误会当中的Y先生是父亲大德。访问完成后素珊表示只说了上半部，更要利用大德替她演戏，殷赏只好和国仁威迫大德合作。

programme.title: 毕打自己人 #86 [粤]
programme.desc: 殷赏带国仁访问城中富豪大杨，惊见向来不羁的他对其样貌平凡的未婚妻Doris千依百顺。殷赏收到闫器通知，指家升无故辞职；殷赏往找家升，他以转换工作环境为由欲胡扯过去，殷赏却认定跟Linda有关。殷赏到「好玩吧」找大德，却看到家升喝至醉醺醺，遂将他送回家。家升向殷赏查问自己可有透露私隐……殷赏采访时碰上Linda和两男子在一起，忍不住上前指责她辜负家升；家升怪责殷赏多管闲事。乐儿来电告知殷赏家升失控，殷赏赶至发现家升竟大发脾气，把家中的家具破坏后躲在天台。此时Linda来电……

programme.title: 毕打自己人 #87 [粤]
programme.desc: Richard欲邀请尧坚打羽毛球，尧坚终鼓起勇气拒绝。尧坚欲销毁为Richard织的毛衣，国仁为鼓励尧坚扬言愿意穿上毛衣，并配衬她早前所赠的颈巾上班。尧坚和Richard在餐厅相遇，国仁为助尧坚，答应和Richard及Herman切磋。尧坚遗失了Richard所赠的球拍，遂找绮琴协助。国仁回家欲找回尧坚所赠的颈巾却无所获，怀疑被三人丢弃。励军从管理员口中得知国仁大费周章找寻颈巾，尧坚得悉后感动。美玲告知尧坚终在杂物房找到球拍……国仁及尧坚胜出与Richard的比赛……

programme.title: 万凰之王 #21 [粤]
programme.desc: 伊兰冒风雪往拜祭颐龄，沅宛同样懒理风雪，把握机会到停堂替爱儿祈福。伊兰回宫时重遇沅宛，透露父亲惨死，更暗示大人的罪孽或会连累下一代。伊兰传召锷泰，将广东巡抚的恶行相告，道光惊悉有官员找来假冒洋人欺骗钦差大臣后，答应重审还颐龄公道。太后对道光冷待自己感心酸，卫公公内疚不已，自毁左目谢罪；太后决定重整旗鼓，替绵忻的将来铺路。太后消渴症日益严重，脚部受感染而溃疡，但她竟冒风雪三跪九叩为孙儿祈福；道光感动原谅太后。舒明阿打算除去锷泰，但却被沅宛阻止。皇后孩儿突然病发，命悬一线……

programme.title: 隔离七日情 #13 [粤]
programme.desc: 早安发现可人独自在天台酒吧喝得半醉，细问下才发现她因遗失了「家传之宝」而担心，早安失笑指那颗黄钻是膺品。唐晶不慎丢掉录音笔并遭嘉嘉拾到。在隔离第六日早上，众住客惊见报纸绘影绘声地歪曲报道酒店内的情况，写尽他们的丑态，情涌。家燕迫俊辉找到出卖住客的人，他指少男最大嫌疑，拉扯间少男身上竟跌出一支录音笔；展龙决定跟踪少男，但遭嘉嘉破坏。展龙到泳池散心，误会贾瑜出了意外，奋不顾身跳进泳池将她救起。国强来到酒店，表面是替员工和住客打气，实质是与仕灿里应外合调查俊朗的下落。

programme.title: 隔离七日情 #14 [粤]
programme.desc: 国强从仓库中找到俊朗的字条，大为紧张，相信儿子确实被绑匪困于酒店；展龙在后楼梯巧遇姚丹，有感她行为古怪而上前查问，被丹带往游花园。戴波得悉国强入住酒店，看穿他为查绑匪而来，遂安排少男制造混乱，让他潜入酒店；而展龙的母亲咏梅亦暗中混入酒店。少男制造小火欲烧毁曾禁锢俊朗的证据；意外地贾瑜被困火场，早安不顾一切进内相救。国强探望贾瑜等人，而重遇俊朗的护士长生母。咏梅喜见儿子，但遭展龙与唐晶发现她与仕灿的关系非比寻常。可人不满遭早安冷待而大发脾气，而质问他何以冲入火场救贾瑜。

programme.title: 凤凰四重奏 #20 [粤]
programme.desc: 在裘设计下珍与仁夫妻反目，另一边厢文借拜姻缘石之机，表白倾慕之情，不料却被卿拒绝。超因钱包被抢追入无上装酒吧，被红误会，纠缠间意外遭车撞伤送院。不料原来却是苦肉计，众男更结成「烂滚团」，趁红、珍等到日本公干寻花问柳。与此同时，坚与萍却被骗徒设局，被敲诈勒索逼跳艳舞，而且更与「烂滚团」狭路相逢，结果落得齐齐被敲竹杠赔上大笔金钱的下场。柔约同江湖老叔父为各人讨回公道，混乱中虎舍身救妻，幸有惊无险。红等提早返港，在酒店房中鬼混的各人险被撞破，但因留下蛛丝马迹，促成「缉私团」成立。

programme.title: 凤凰四重奏 #21 [粤]
programme.desc: 虎因受命调查跨国卖淫集团，于是加入以超为首的「烂滚团」到处风流。虽红布下陷阱，但因被发现而未能成功。虎被安排以失枪为由被停职，不料柔却到处张罗买枪以作解决，虽令人啼笑皆非，却让虎大为感动。卿与文意外发现汪子君与凤凰餐厅的渊源，珍决定大力推广，仁在裘设计下持相反意见，二人更是势成水火。而超等各人终与卖淫集团接触，众女亦得仁通风报信，杀上宾馆捉奸在床。超、坚等均被赶出家门，珍失望离开，各人于是借此机暂居仁家中。众女在网球场上与教练眉来眼去以作为报复，看得各人咬牙切齿。

programme.title: 毕打自己人 #85 [粤]
programme.desc: 素珊到服装店挑选新装，首富袁有成的太太看中刚被素珊批评得体无完肤的款式，素珊竟从店员手上抢回，表示她刚试完应有优先购买权；此时有成步入时装店，并表示会命人到巴黎总站订货，素珊感酸溜溜。迟来的素珊得知丽薇因未能约见一富豪而生气，夸口她可以约到。然而丽薇欲约见的竟是有成。素珊无法推搪，遂要求闫器著殷赏重新访问她一次。殷赏专访素珊，她道出一段鲜为人知的感情创伤，令殷赏误会当中的Y先生是父亲大德。访问完成后素珊表示只说了上半部，更要利用大德替她演戏，殷赏只好和国仁威迫大德合作。

programme.title: 毕打自己人 #86 [粤]
programme.desc: 殷赏带国仁访问城中富豪大杨，惊见向来不羁的他对其样貌平凡的未婚妻Doris千依百顺。殷赏收到闫器通知，指家升无故辞职；殷赏往找家升，他以转换工作环境为由欲胡扯过去，殷赏却认定跟Linda有关。殷赏到「好玩吧」找大德，却看到家升喝至醉醺醺，遂将他送回家。家升向殷赏查问自己可有透露私隐……殷赏采访时碰上Linda和两男子在一起，忍不住上前指责她辜负家升；家升怪责殷赏多管闲事。乐儿来电告知殷赏家升失控，殷赏赶至发现家升竟大发脾气，把家中的家具破坏后躲在天台。此时Linda来电……

programme.title: 毕打自己人 #87 [粤]
programme.desc: Richard欲邀请尧坚打羽毛球，尧坚终鼓起勇气拒绝。尧坚欲销毁为Richard织的毛衣，国仁为鼓励尧坚扬言愿意穿上毛衣，并配衬她早前所赠的颈巾上班。尧坚和Richard在餐厅相遇，国仁为助尧坚，答应和Richard及Herman切磋。尧坚遗失了Richard所赠的球拍，遂找绮琴协助。国仁回家欲找回尧坚所赠的颈巾却无所获，怀疑被三人丢弃。励军从管理员口中得知国仁大费周章找寻颈巾，尧坚得悉后感动。美玲告知尧坚终在杂物房找到球拍……国仁及尧坚胜出与Richard的比赛……

programme.title: 花样爷爷听见狗狗的声音 #1 [粤/韩]
programme.desc: 老牌演员李纯才因为缺德行为而被唾弃，因此来到巨济岛避世。另一老牌演员金容建请了一众朋友来到巨济岛，跟纯才一起生活。岛上发生死亡事件，女网红在车上死亡，这时候，纯才发现自己竟然能跟狗狗Sophie沟通…

programme.title: 从夺走你的那天起 #1 [日]
programme.desc: 描述十年前，因一场食品安全事故失去年仅三岁的孩子母亲中越纮海的故事。造成意外的熟食店社长结城旭成为她复仇的目标。在命运的交错之下，纮海意外绑架了旭年仅三岁的次女，试图以此实现自己的复仇。

programme.title: 香港 '83 #238 [粤]
programme.desc: 陈积介绍顺嫂等人去买名牌时装，顺叔却连试穿也不肯。顺叔欲想借钱给老友，顺嫂故意令那老友知难而退。顺叔知顺嫂赶走他的朋友后大发雷霆，最终平息风波。翌日顺嫂出门前被骗钱，顺叔得悉后忍不住又教训了她一顿。

programme.title: 为爱结婚 #8 [普]
programme.desc: 讲述陆弥和胡子冲这对恋人，冲破生活的重重阻力，成了为爱结婚的践行者，并因为爱情而真正生活在一起，然而却因一场意外的家庭变故及其连锁作用，被推到了绝境———既是生活的绝境，也是爱情的绝境的故事。

programme.title: 关于唐医生的一切 #12 [普]
programme.desc: 以「全磁悬浮人工心脏」研制的真实故事为背景，讲述安和医院心脏外科主任唐佳瑜携一众同仁，解决了28个高难罕见的心脏病例，通过各种案例描绘医者们的百态人生，将真实反映各种社会焦点问题。

programme.title: 灿烂的遗产 #31 [粤/韩]
programme.desc: 流离失所的高恩诚在偶然机会下救了大财团会长一命，想不到竟被会长视如亲孙女般接返家，更获得遗产继承权。因祸得福的恩诚却因此遭受原本的继承人，会长的嫡孙鲜于焕敌意对待，于焕誓要夺回家族产业的控制权。

programme.title: 香港 '83 #239 [粤]
programme.desc: 天气转冷，斌仔的被太细太薄，斌仔因而伤风。同学约斌仔去露营，他带病出发。陈积为了巴结老板，答应陪他一起晨运。斌仔终于因病而晕倒。陈积试了斌仔的被，发觉真的不够暖。陈积回来被懋叔等人训示，他终于知错。

programme.title: 刑事侦缉档案 IV #23 [粤]
programme.desc: 兰透露泰被绑架时，曾请求公司合伙人骆见业借千二万，可惜被拒绝，警方怀疑业谋财害命，全力调查时发现泰以往常到澳门豪赌及借贷，并且有赌友雄陪伴，飞接到雄由菲律宾寄来的明信片说遇到芊，飞决定到菲律宾。君在飞家中毒，被送入医院急救，令飞担心不已。警方继续调查雄失踪，飞再盘问Simon，经过DNA的证实，先前发现的无头尸体是雄而非泰，令到飞非常难过。

programme.title: 刑事侦缉档案 IV #24 [粤]
programme.desc: 飞为调查无头尸案而显得心绪不宁，与山发生争吵。医院突然接到匿名信，信上写有君中毒药物名称，飞感疑惑。山偷听兰的电话，得知有绑匪再度勒索，于是布下天罗地网捉拿，拘捕了业。在种种不利证据下，业说出当年和兰的母亲慧有不伦之恋，由于泰对慧不解温柔，令慧对他心灰意冷，并答应跟业私奔，可惜被泰知道，向慧大兴问罪，慧羞愧自杀，业认为对不起兰，于是愿意不断帮助泰，但兰不信，更认为是他害死自己母亲的。

programme.title: 关于唐医生的一切 #12 [普]
programme.desc: 以「全磁悬浮人工心脏」研制的真实故事为背景，讲述安和医院心脏外科主任唐佳瑜携一众同仁，解决了28个高难罕见的心脏病例，通过各种案例描绘医者们的百态人生，将真实反映各种社会焦点问题。

programme.title: 香港 '83 #239 [粤]
programme.desc: 天气转冷，斌仔的被太细太薄，斌仔因而伤风。同学约斌仔去露营，他带病出发。陈积为了巴结老板，答应陪他一起晨运。斌仔终于因病而晕倒。陈积试了斌仔的被，发觉真的不够暖。陈积回来被懋叔等人训示，他终于知错。

programme.title: 香港原味道 #2 [粤]
programme.desc: 港产青枣贵精不贵多，庭锋、德丞亲手采摘翠绿饱满本地有机青枣，粒粒皮薄多汁。藏在泥中的竹芋(粉薯)不为香港人熟悉，阿谭、幸美掘起成束竹芋，一见庐山真面目！元朗菇场日产一千五百公斤蘑菇，深入「菇阵」，了解蘑菇生长过程；再品尝中、西蘑菇菜式，正到唔停到口。三十年历史人气车仔面店，新一代传人延续爷爷创立的品牌，将传统美食发光发亮。汤底新鲜、卤水汁足料、材料入味，配上秘制辣汁无得输，入厨房一看制作「秘技」。

programme.title: 法证先锋 #25 [粤]
programme.desc: (大结局)博遭嫁祸，被牵涉入放置假炸弹案，忆起曾在商场遇到一个小丑，怀疑是他套取了自己的指纹，在四处寻找小丑时遇伏。博醒来后发现被小丑囚禁于货柜中，小丑声言设计了一场游戏，要让博的同伴眼睁睁的看著他死去，博深信众人定能救自己出生天。柔接获包裹，骇然发现博被困的录影片段，众侦查博失踪的经过。琛接获博出现缺水症状的片段，焦急不已。汀从一架失车中找到博遗下的戒指，从而查出是Tracy好友苏志文所为，遂将他拘捕，文在羁留期间自杀身亡。博缺水四天，奄奄一息，他在弥留之际看见瑶及柔……

programme.title: 法证先锋II #1 [粤]
programme.desc: 野战场内有人中枪死去，在场的另一处有小丑中枪昏迷，尚有人死在捕兽笼中，帼英指死者正鸿与毒品交易案有关。伤者叶志文苏醒，证实与中枪死者陈子成不认识。柔查询正鸿工作上的事项，帼英出现，阻止柔拘捕贵归案。

programme.title: 法证先锋II #2 [粤]
programme.desc: 博玩高频铃声游戏，联想到案发现场高频声音来自狗笛，因此寻获改装过的凶枪，成功将凶手拘捕，但凶手只承认杀其中一人，英从东口中知鸿之死可能与石头勇有关。贵在会所遭杀手放置手榴弹，青年杨逸升出现阻止爆炸。

programme.title: 出走地图 #17 [粤/普]
programme.desc: 巩姿希带萧新亭走出首尔，包车畅游邻近景点。首站到杨平郡的大川海水浴场，玩21层楼高的高空滑索、踏高空单车饱覧海边美景，再去品尝滋补的「汉方松茸土鸡锅」，肉质鲜嫩。韩国人喜欢饮枳椇子饮品清除体内毒素，新亭与姿希到访生产这种国宝茶的基地，能否打探到韩国人保持活力的秘密？奉化郡每年夏天举办香鱼节，可以尝试徒手或以鱼网捞鱼，捞到香鱼更可即席烹调，味道如何？姿希还介绍民宿的贴心服务，不容错过。

programme.title: 出走地图 #18 [粤/普]
programme.desc: 朱祐宏、苏子芸来到马来西亚的槟城，发掘当地的隐世景点。首站畅游出售各种特色手工艺品的文创市集，充满文青气息。再来前往峇都丁宜海滩，出海试玩拖曳伞，体验翱翔天际的快感。祐宏、子芸还随名师学习烹调「五香卤肉」、「娘惹甲必丹咖哩鸡」，到底娘惹菜有何特色？两人的手艺又如何？槟城拥有全球最高的空中玻璃步道，可远眺乔治城和马六甲海峡的美景，高空漫步，更可挑战胆量。祐宏又介绍一间隐密酒吧，体验槟城人的夜生活。

programme.title: 蓝色生死恋 #11 [韩]
programme.desc: 小时候的尹俊熙因为贪玩把恩熙跟芯爱的名牌弄乱导致护士阴错阳差的把两名婴儿的名牌搞错。原本在幸福美满家庭中长大的俊熙和恩熙兄妹，却在一次车祸中，因为血液检查而得知了真相的恩熙，一夕之间变成了灰姑娘...

programme.title: 为爱结婚 #9 [普]
programme.desc: 讲述陆弥和胡子冲这对恋人，冲破生活的重重阻力，成了为爱结婚的践行者，并因为爱情而真正生活在一起，然而却因一场意外的家庭变故及其连锁作用，被推到了绝境———既是生活的绝境，也是爱情的绝境的故事。

programme.title: 关于唐医生的一切 #13 [普]
programme.desc: 以「全磁悬浮人工心脏」研制的真实故事为背景，讲述安和医院心脏外科主任唐佳瑜携一众同仁，解决了28个高难罕见的心脏病例，通过各种案例描绘医者们的百态人生，将真实反映各种社会焦点问题。

programme.title: 灿烂的遗产 #32 [粤/韩]
programme.desc: 流离失所的高恩诚在偶然机会下救了大财团会长一命，想不到竟被会长视如亲孙女般接返家，更获得遗产继承权。因祸得福的恩诚却因此遭受原本的继承人，会长的嫡孙鲜于焕敌意对待，于焕誓要夺回家族产业的控制权。

programme.title: 香港 '83 #240 [粤]
programme.desc: 牛太的大哥来探望她，想问牛太借六千元，牛太问牛生相借。牛生心情不好，牛太正想跟他说大哥借钱的事，他又赶去开局。陈积见牛太与男人在一起，立即向牛生通风报讯，牛生立即回家怒打奸夫，不料见到那人是其大舅。

programme.title: 刑事侦缉档案 IV #25 [粤]
programme.desc: 山发现兰家中有一地下密室，怀疑是泰一直匿藏的地方，当兰在密室不见泰时，知他一定是去找业寻仇。泰一直对业怀恨在心，当业有意结婚后移民外国，便设计陷害他和诈取保险金，由于雄的血形和自己一样，泰便利用他做替死鬼，并说服兰去认尸和领取保险金。后来飞发现泰和雄的关系，泰便到飞家中落毒,却误中副车令君中毒，兰知君无辜，于是写匿名信救她，而最无辜是Ben因遇上泰而被杀，泰最终判监二十年，兰亦被判十四个月，令山非常伤心。

programme.title: 刑事侦缉档案 IV #26 [粤]
programme.desc: 山一心一意等兰出狱，但兰拒绝他的好意。君父强虽对香有意，但香仍恨强当年北上寻欢。强在大陆的儿子杰申请来港，强为安抚杰母，答应给她二十万，但途中被人抢劫且受伤，香答应借钱给他，令强非常感动。小说家程柏举行签名会，吸引了大量书迷，包括两位超级书迷李宝屏和张素玲。杰不适应港生活，觉得受人歧视，后遇上初恋情人屏，得到介绍到酒店工作。屏被贵利追债，杰偷了香的金钱代屏还钱，屏因杰家人反对遂向他提出分手。

programme.title: 为爱结婚 #9 [普]
programme.desc: 讲述陆弥和胡子冲这对恋人，冲破生活的重重阻力，成了为爱结婚的践行者，并因为爱情而真正生活在一起，然而却因一场意外的家庭变故及其连锁作用，被推到了绝境———既是生活的绝境，也是爱情的绝境的故事。

programme.title: 香港 '83 #241 [粤]
programme.desc: 懋叔拿旅行的相片给顺叔等人看，有一张相竟是懋叔拖著一个女人的合照。觉悟因的老婆叫她的表妹来帮忙，她正是懋叔的团友。团友主动约懋叔出外吃饭，与他诉说心事。懋叔以为团友钟情于自己，最后懋叔才知自己表错情。

programme.title: 刑事侦缉档案 IV #27 [粤]
programme.desc: 屏被人谋杀后弃尸沙滩，刚巧杰经过被警方怀疑他是凶手，由于他的不合作令他很不利，幸君从中开解。兰为令山死心，在探监名单中删除他的名字，山无奈。玉从台湾来找寻失踪多天的姊姊玲，警方怀疑玲和柏关系密切，对柏展开调查，不过柏有青做时间证人，证明案发当日与他一齐在酒店工作。杰工作时发现一男子莫耀风尸体，警方正全力追查同党陈志豪的时候，发现强当晚的财物是被风和豪所劫；而警方在山上发现女尸，证明是玲的尸体。

programme.title: 刑事侦缉档案 IV #28 [粤]
programme.desc: 警方在玲保险单内发现受益人是柏，显示他们关系密切，由于没有充份证据落案控告他，玉便去暗杀柏，幸被警方阻止。飞联想到案发当日，缇亦是同时撞车，根据缇提供资料，知道柏和屏的车曾经相撞，当时柏的车正被人偷去，但他竟然没有报警。柏在夜总会结识玲后同居，柏江郎才尽，所写小说便由玲代笔，后竟大受读者欢迎，因此玲用此威胁柏跟她结婚，两人时有冲突，柏一时错手杀死她，但他却强调没有杀屏，令屏的凶案悬空。

programme.desc: 屏被人谋杀后弃尸沙滩，刚巧杰经过被警方怀疑他是凶手，由于他的不合作令他很不利，幸君从中开解。兰为令山死心，在探监名单中删除他的名字，山无奈。玉从台湾来找寻失踪多天的姊姊玲，警方怀疑玲和柏关系密切，对柏展开调查，不过柏有青做时间证人，证明案发当日与他一齐在酒店工作。杰工作时发现一男子莫耀风尸体，警方正全力追查同党陈志豪的时候，发现强当晚的财物是被风和豪所劫；而警方在山上发现女尸，证明是玲的尸体。

programme.title: 刑事侦缉档案 IV #28 [粤]
programme.desc: 警方在玲保险单内发现受益人是柏，显示他们关系密切，由于没有充份证据落案控告他，玉便去暗杀柏，幸被警方阻止。飞联想到案发当日，缇亦是同时撞车，根据缇提供资料，知道柏和屏的车曾经相撞，当时柏的车正被人偷去，但他竟然没有报警。柏在夜总会结识玲后同居，柏江郎才尽，所写小说便由玲代笔，后竟大受读者欢迎，因此玲用此威胁柏跟她结婚，两人时有冲突，柏一时错手杀死她，但他却强调没有杀屏，令屏的凶案悬空。

programme.title: 为爱结婚 #10 [普]
programme.desc: 讲述陆弥和胡子冲这对恋人，冲破生活的重重阻力，成了为爱结婚的践行者，并因为爱情而真正生活在一起，然而却因一场意外的家庭变故及其连锁作用，被推到了绝境———既是生活的绝境，也是爱情的绝境的故事。

programme.title: 香港 '83 #242 [粤]
programme.desc: 康仔的皮肤出现问题，懋叔著众人小心燥热。斌仔涂了润唇膏，被陈积取笑。夜里，斌仔流鼻血，陈积则肚痛大作。陈积向老板推销洗头水，但他的头屑令老板却步。康仔以砂糖洗澡以滋润皮肤，夜里被蟑螂所咬，被众人取笑。

programme.title: 刑事侦缉档案 IV #29 [粤]
programme.desc: 杰无意中发现仲的车尾灯坏了一盏，联想屏遇害当晚所见，于是便向仲大兴问罪，反被仲以君做人质要胁警方，幸得飞机警解困。君觉得在飞心目中的地位不及芊，正想分手时，飞向她表白爱意。如请了洛伟基做经理，负责打理餐厅，由于他处事大公无私，令到餐厅上下都心服口服。邱Sir和缇在餐厅举行结婚纪念，专诚来餐厅试菜，遇到基的舅仔，觉得缇非常面熟。香和强感情越来越好，正计划结婚之际，强验出患上鼻咽癌。

programme.title: 刑事侦缉档案 IV #30 [粤]
programme.desc: 为了拒绝香的好意，和杰合作单打她，令香在酒吧借酒消愁时，遇到邱Sir，引致缇误会二人有私情。君觉得杰和强感情越来越好，反而父女的感情渐淡，飞安慰她；如醉心学习调酒，不惜到果园偷荔枝，园主说要告她令山啼笑皆非。缇看见邱Sir收藏香所送的银包非常生气，一怒之下离家，由于她整夜没有回家，令邱Sir非常担心，餐厅内的酒窖发现女尸，竟然是失踪的缇。兰计划出狱后离开香港，所以希望山不要再等，山心如刀割。

programme.title: 关于唐医生的一切 #15 [普]
programme.desc: 以「全磁悬浮人工心脏」研制的真实故事为背景，讲述安和医院心脏外科主任唐佳瑜携一众同仁，解决了28个高难罕见的心脏病例，通过各种案例描绘医者们的百态人生，将真实反映各种社会焦点问题。

programme.title: 灿烂的遗产 #34 [粤/韩]
programme.desc: 流离失所的高恩诚在偶然机会下救了大财团会长一命，想不到竟被会长视如亲孙女般接返家，更获得遗产继承权。因祸得福的恩诚却因此遭受原本的继承人，会长的嫡孙鲜于焕敌意对待，于焕誓要夺回家族产业的控制权。

programme.title: 香港 '83 #242 [粤]
programme.desc: 康仔的皮肤出现问题，懋叔著众人小心燥热。斌仔涂了润唇膏，被陈积取笑。夜里，斌仔流鼻血，陈积则肚痛大作。陈积向老板推销洗头水，但他的头屑令老板却步。康仔以砂糖洗澡以滋润皮肤，夜里被蟑螂所咬，被众人取笑。

programme.title: SUPER九点半神剧 - 刑事侦缉档案 IV #29 [粤]
programme.desc: 杰无意中发现仲的车尾灯坏了一盏，联想屏遇害当晚所见，于是便向仲大兴问罪，反被仲以君做人质要胁警方，幸得飞机警解困。君觉得在飞心目中的地位不及芊，正想分手时，飞向她表白爱意。如请了洛伟基做经理，负责打理餐厅，由于他处事大公无私，令到餐厅上下都心服口服。邱Sir和缇在餐厅举行结婚纪念，专诚来餐厅试菜，遇到基的舅仔，觉得缇非常面熟。香和强感情越来越好，正计划结婚之际，强验出患上鼻咽癌。

programme.title: SUPER九点半神剧 - 刑事侦缉档案 IV #30 [粤]
programme.desc: 为了拒绝香的好意，和杰合作单打她，令香在酒吧借酒消愁时，遇到邱Sir，引致缇误会二人有私情。君觉得杰和强感情越来越好，反而父女的感情渐淡，飞安慰她；如醉心学习调酒，不惜到果园偷荔枝，园主说要告她令山啼笑皆非。缇看见邱Sir收藏香所送的银包非常生气，一怒之下离家，由于她整夜没有回家，令邱Sir非常担心，餐厅内的酒窖发现女尸，竟然是失踪的缇。兰计划出狱后离开香港，所以希望山不要再等，山心如刀割。

programme.title: Speedy Pea
programme.desc: Evil Pea steals Supertato's brand new Tato Car but doesn't realise that the Grape Kids are in the back seat. Supertato has to get the Grape Kids back to safety and save his car.

programme.title: Endless Love
programme.desc: A young girl encounters a novelist in a bar and quickly falls in love with him. However, it turns out she has fallen into a trap set up by the novelist and his ex-girlfriend who is a ghost with a disfigured face. The journey of revenge and ultimate terror has just begun!

programme.title: Behind the Yellow Line
programme.desc: A fresh graduate, Paul, strikes up an acquaintance with a pretty young girl, Monica, on the metro. Monica is involved in a love affair with a married man while Paul is also pursued by a rich girl. When Paul vows his true love for Monica, she suggests playing hide-and-seek with him in the metro to decide if they are fated to be together.

programme.title: The Mad Monk
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays an arrogant god in Heaven who is being punished for his pranks and mistakes. He is sent to Earth and reincarnate as Mad Monk to change the destiny of three misguided souls - a prostitute, a beggar and a villain. The Mad Monk needs to complete the task in three days in order to return to Heaven.

programme.title: Cruel War
programme.desc: To combat the greenhouse effect, scientist Yan Xin attempts to plant newly developed super rubber seeds on a remote island, hoping to transform it into a thriving new land. Yan Xin's ex-husband decides to accompany her on this perilous journey. As conflicts arise, they encounter the local drug cartel, and a fatal battle is about to begin.

programme.title: Kungfu Stuntmen
programme.desc: Hong Kong action cinema is famous for its real kung fu moves performed by a group called "Kung Fu Stuntmen". This docu-film pays tribute to the generations of kung fu stuntmen, with the crew spending over two years digging archives and interviewing many talents, including the most prominent masters like Jackie Chan, Donnie Yen and Sammo Hung.

programme.title: The Grey Men
programme.desc: Hong Kong police officer Ah Shan goes undercover in prison to gain the trust of criminal Tian, in order to seek evidence against his gang. After their release from jail, Shan helps Tian rise within the gang and become the new boss. However, just as Shan successfully cracks down on the gang, he uncovers a shocking secret about Tian...

programme.title: Teenage Dreamers
programme.desc: Ting Ting is a student in an all-girl high school. She tries out for the school's stage production of Romeo and Juliet with an all-boy school and promptly falls for the lead, Jackson. While Ting Ting is swept away by the excitement of her first love, Jackson turns out to be more of a player than a partner.

programme.title: Mr Vampire
programme.desc: Taoist priest Kou is assigned to re-bury a rich man, in the hope that the new tomb will bring further prosperity. When the corpse turns into a vampire and wreaks havoc in the village, his disciples are also hurt by the vampire and possessed by a female ghost respectively. How can Kou save his disciples and hunt down the vampire at the same time?

programme.title: Fight Back to School II
programme.desc: Following his demotion, officer Sing resigns from the police force and goes undercover at an international school to privately investigate a terrorist plot. There, he discovers bumbling detective Tat posing as a teacher. Forced into an alliance, they team up to confront the heavily armed criminals behind the plot in a chaotic showdown.

programme.title: Forbidden City Cop
programme.desc: A wild and hilariously anachronistic tale of an imperial guard of the Forbidden City who has no martial arts abilities. When the emperor is abducted, he saved the day with his unusual hobby: tinkering with futuristic inventions!

programme.title: Turns We Take
programme.desc: A spicy hot pot restaurant in Northeast China serves different types of customers every day. Amongst them are a sweet young couple, two wayward young men and a taxi driver. Despite being complete strangers to each other, their lives are intertwined by a traffic accident...

programme.title: Perfect Girls
programme.desc: Chi will inherit his dying grandfather's fortune with one condition - he has to be married in a month, otherwise the money goes to his uncle, Robert. Chi falls in love with Siu Siu, but Robert intends to stop them by sending Moraine to seduce Chi. When Moraine decides to marry Chi for money, Robert stops her and reveals their plot.

programme.title: Fate Jealous Greed
programme.desc: The film consists of three short horror stories: a man tries to survive after he received a haunted mail predicting his death; while a man mourns the death of his beloved wife, she becomes a ghost and tries to communicate with him; three brothers clash over the care options of their elderly mother during dinner, leading to a terrifying murder.

programme.title: Iron Kung Fu Fist
programme.desc: Liang Kun is a skilled martial arts master who left the martial arts world to protect his lover. However, his disappearance leads to her tragic death and as Liang Kun finds a way to survive in the martial arts world, he fights back to avenge his lover's death with the help of a beggar gang leader.

programme.title: Faithfully Yours
programme.desc: Playboy Hong Kong Barber Happy Chan opens a fashionable new salon, right next to an old-fashioned Shanhainese barber shop. Its owner, Chuk, is furious at this development and starts a quarrel with Chan and his colleagues during the opening ceremony of his new venture Chuk's pretty daughter, Ying, is forced to keep the peace. Chan and his friends all attempt to woo Ying, but end up getting drunk and falling asleep in her bedroom.

programme.title: Casino Tycoon II
programme.desc: This is a sequel to "Casino Tycoon". 20 years after Benny Ho established his casino empire in Macau, his former partner becomes envious and plots to bring him down. At the same time, a young man working for Benny is the son of his ex-lover, and is also out to take revenge on him. Ho however, is not about to take things lying down...

programme.title: Oily Maniac
programme.desc: Famous director Ho Meng-hua, who gave Jackie Chan and Sammo Hung acting breaks in his early kung-fu films, broke new ground with his horror hit Oily Maniac. Based on a true story about a creature that kills people at night and covers them in oil, it stars young actor Danny Lee (aka. Li Hsiu-hsien) as the oily maniac. It was considered so scary that it was censored drastically.

programme.title: Hong Kong Hong Kong
programme.desc: After moving to Hong Kong, illegal immigrant Mang has no choice but to live in cramped quarters with male migrants who abuse her. In order to attain Hong Kong residency and a better life, she agrees to marry a lonely old carpenter. After her marriage, Mang crosses paths again with her ex-lover, and the two develop a passionate affair...

programme.title: Cop Shop Babes
programme.desc: Island East Police Station headed by Madam Lui is known for its "Cop Shop Babes" as all the officers there are female. Two police officers, Beer and Satay, apply for an internal transfer to this station in order to approach the girls. It is at this time that the police receives a bomb threat - can they resolve the case?

programme.title: The Grey Men 2
programme.desc: Triad boss Song seeks to whitewash his image and seize Laika's mayoral seat amid a regime change. He faces a funding shortfall despite colluding with officials, and gets his right-hand man and enforcer to commit crimes to boost his funds and power. Just as Song believes success is imminent, the dynamics between the three take an unexpected turn...

programme.title: Mother VS Mother
programme.desc: Guan De Xing fell in love with Li Xiao Yun when he was young, but was opposed by his mother and had to marry Zhou Shen Yu. Since then, Li holds a grudge against Zhou. Unfortunately, the son of Guan and Zhou falls in love with Li's daughter, and as the two mothers meet, they start brawling again!

programme.title: Mr Vampire II
programme.desc: Grave-robbing archaeologists unearth a family of preserved vampires and plan to sell them on the black market. However, they accidentally break the paper spells that had kept the vampires immobilized during transport. The vampires escape, but a local herbalist Lin is soon on their trail, determined to destroy them.

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: A heroic tale about Hong Kong's brave firefighters. These courageous men can march into disastrous firegrounds and risk their lives to save others. However, do they have the same courage to confront their personal issues?

programme.title: Iceman the Time Traveler
programme.desc: In this sequel, the four imperial guards are defrosted and reanimated in modern Hong Kong. Driven by a single goal to obtain the Golden Wheel of Time and right the wrongs of the past, Ying embarks on a perilous quest, unaware that every step draws him deeper into a deadly trap.

programme.title: Out of the Dark
programme.desc: An old lady died after mysteriously falling off a building and her ghost appears to haunt the place. This freaked out the security guards, who invite ghostbuster Leo and his female assistant to help. In the process, Leo finds out that the old lady was killed by her son and daughter in law. To rest her soul, Leo promises to bring the couple to justice.

programme.title: Look Out, Officer!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow is a delight in this supernatural action comedy, where a murdered police officer returns from beyond the grave to persuade a rookie cop into avenging his death.

programme.title: Ip Man 2
programme.desc: After the Sino-Japanese war, Wing Chun grandmaster Ip Man and his family experience hardship in their hometown and eventually moved to Hong Kong for a new life. He wants to open a martial arts school in Hong Kong, but first he must pass and win the challenges put forth by the local martial arts grandmasters.

programme.title: (PG) Episode 15: And The Lucky Father Is (CN/Eng/Mal Subs)
programme.desc: Margaret is left devastated after her big date doesn't go the way she planned. Min Yi takes a huge risk after a big job announcement to her family backfires. Nabilah finds herself in over her head as she tries to help a friend at school, while Hillary's stress eating intensifies. Meanwhile, Grace anxiously awaits the results of Kyra's DNA test.

programme.title: (PG) Episode 14 - The Light at the End of the Tunnel (Eng Subs)
programme.desc: Yu-Gi-Oh! follows the adventures of high school student Yugi, who has a magical secret that comes to life when he plays his favorite card game.

programme.title: (PG) Episode 3 - Bunch of Misfits / Brawl or Nothing (Eng Subs)
programme.desc: The Bakugan brawlers are back with new Bakugan buddies! Watch out for an all new origin story.

programme.title: Episode 3 (Eng Subs)
programme.desc: (Dual Language English and Mandarin) Super BOOMi follows an animated bear and his friends as they learn and play in a virtual reality game universe.

programme.title: Episode 4 (Eng Subs)
programme.desc: (Dual Language English and Mandarin) Super BOOMi follows an animated bear and his friends as they learn and play in a virtual reality game universe.

programme.title: Episode 29 - Blippi the Jack O’Lantern
programme.desc: Come explore the world with Blippi! There are so many exciting things to explore and learn. Feed your kids' curiosity while they learn about vehicles, animals, the natural world and so much more.

programme.title: Episode 4 - Power Cut/Get In Line (Eng Subs)
programme.desc: After Imp steals the Mega Battery, Ollipolis' power source, Ollie and his friends work together to reclaim the battery and restore power to Ollipolis. Alien 1 refuses to queue up. He demonstrates the power of his box. The Imp sees it and steals the box. The Triangle Aliens learns the Importance of queuing up.

programme.title: Episode 68
programme.desc: Join Pinkfong and friends for more fun and adventure.

programme.title: Episode 34 - Tee Ball Trouble
programme.desc: The season's main curricular goals are mindfulness and expressing one's feelings.

programme.title: Episode 1 - Go Jet Academy: Compass Navigators (Eng Subs)
programme.desc: The series has lots more of the comedy, teamwork, great gadgets (including a brand new vehicle), awesome sights and funky facts about amazing landmarks that young viewers and their parents have come to love. Travelling the world with their teacher, mentor and friend Ubercorn, a disco-grooving unicorn, the Go Jetters are fixing the mishaps caused by the mischievous meddlings of Grandmaster Glitch in new locations including Central Park in New York, Machu Picchu, China, Japan, Mali, and Petra.

programme.title: Episode 2 - Wolong Panda Reserve, China (Eng Subs)
programme.desc: The series has lots more of the comedy, teamwork, great gadgets (including a brand new vehicle), awesome sights and funky facts about amazing landmarks that young viewers and their parents have come to love. Travelling the world with their teacher, mentor and friend Ubercorn, a disco-grooving unicorn, the Go Jetters are fixing the mishaps caused by the mischievous meddlings of Grandmaster Glitch in new locations including Central Park in New York, Machu Picchu, China, Japan, Mali, and Petra.

programme.title: Episode 5 (Eng Subs)
programme.desc: Jax doesn't want to go to school because he believes he can learn everything from the library. Meanwhile, Vicky doesn't want to go to school because she doesn't want to leave her favorite things alone behind. How will Rover and Jinxy help them see that a school is also a fun learning environment too?

programme.title: Plugger's New Job

programme.title: Clamshell Day
programme.desc: Kelp is excited to celebrate his right of passage, breaking the ice with his horn. But when he struggles to break the ice like other narwhals, he is determined to do it "the Kelp way."

programme.title: Game of Horns
programme.desc: At a big town festival, Magnus challenges Duggard in a competition to be chief of Huttsgalor! Can the Riders help their friend keep his helmet?

programme.title: Crimson And Clover
programme.desc: Clover's wild, party-girl twin sister Crimson visits and King Julien is instantly smitten.

programme.title: Pineapple Of My Eye
programme.desc: Masikura tricks King Julien into believing that a pineapple contains all the souls and wisdom of the previous Julien Kings.

programme.title: Captain Underpants and the Worrisome Wedge of the Water Warmongers
programme.desc: Harold and George can't wait to spend the summer together at camp. But not so fast, boys -- your old nemesis Mr. Krupp has a most unpleasant surprise.

programme.title: Captain Underpants and the Angry Abnormal Atrocities of the Astute Animal Agressors
programme.desc: Stuck in separate camps, Harold and George unleash a hyperintelligent talking possum to scare the pants off of Krupp. What could possibly go wrong?

programme.title: Driving Blind
programme.desc: Now broken out of mind control, Layla goes undercover with the gang, hiding the fact that she’s no longer being controlled. The crew is shocked to discover that revered martyr Rafaela Moreno is still alive and is the mastermind behind the mind control plot. Rafaela puts Layla’s driving to the test in a wild race against a mystery driver, then takes the rest of the crew hostage just days before Rafaela's dastardly plot.

programme.title: An Echo of Nowhere
programme.desc: Now in Rafaela’s custody, the crew works together to break Echo out to retrieve the hauler. Echo makes it into the jungle and must battle a mind-controlled Ms. Nowhere using everything she’s learned about spying and survival from the very woman who's out to get her. Meanwhile, Rafaela enlists Frostee to help her develop a non-exploding version of the mind control formula before her plan goes into motion at the favela race.

programme.title: Chaser And Chewer / Recipe For Adventure
programme.desc: Tag and Scooch pretend to be their favorite comic book heroes and help the dogs of Pawston. But when Frank and Beans pretend to be villains it’s up to Chaser and Chewer to stop the trouble makers and save the day. \ It’s Bring Your Own Bowl Night at the Barker house, and Tag and Grandmaw team up to make Great Great Auntie Eunice's Famous Far Fetched Cookies. But the obscure ingredients are hard to find, so they have to team up and go on an adventure.

programme.title: Raiders of the Lost Bark / Slow, Dog. Slow!
programme.desc: When Tag and Scooch break Gilber’s ancient Golden Slipper, they embark on an adventure to a secret cave to retrieve the matching slipper. \ For community outreach day, the Race Cadets are paired with an elderly resident of Pawston. It's Tag and Scooch's job to take old dog Leo around town for a day of slow, relaxing activities. But when Leo wants to kickbarx, row and skydive, Tag and Scooch try their best to keep up.

programme.title: The Glitter Guide / Piano Panic
programme.desc: When the Dews find out their glitter guide (an older Dew Drop) is coming to visit, they bend over backwards to make a great first impression, but end up forgetting some of their responsiblities in the process. / When a string breaks on Marcus’ piano before his recital and he can’t practice, the Dews must lead Marcus to a new piano.

programme.title: Dew Drops Day Off / Up All Night
programme.desc: When the Dew Drops have the day off, they discover their families still need their help when they’re not around. / Harper needs a good night’s sleep before her first day of Cooking Camp. But when an overtired Nicholas keeps her awake, the Dews must help keep Nicholas quiet, even if it takes all night.

programme.title: Harmony Harbor's Holiday Surprise
programme.desc: When the townsfolk decorate the Harmony Harbor holiday tree but lose the treetop star, TZG secretly search for it in the yard of a notoriously scary house. / When it transpires the house is not-so-scary after all and belongs to shy inventor Dr. Greenlittle, TZG secretly leads her to the big Harmony Harbor sing-along so that she doesn't have to spend the holiday alone.

programme.title: The Big Sleep-Walk / Of Course You Can
programme.desc: When Ian starts to sleepwalk around Harmony Harbor, TZG secretly guides him back to his own bed where he can continue sleeping safely. / When Felicia wants to run an obstacle course for the first time but is afraid she’ll embarrass herself, TZG secretly boosts her confidence by helping with practice.

programme.title: Let's Make A Movie!
programme.desc: When Gabby unboxes two little containers of popcorn and two movie tickets, it’s movie night in the dollhouse! Demanding Director CatRat leads the Gabby Cats through a Gabby-fied version of a classic story, Gabby-locks and the Three Bears.

programme.title: Pete The Polar Bear
programme.desc: Pete the Polar Bear shows up for a vacation on MerCat’s sunny beach. Gabby, Pandy, and the Gabby Cats show Pete he can have a great vacation, even if things don’t go precisely to plan.

programme.title: Thunk O'clock High / The Croo-Gitive
programme.desc: Thunk must face a bully that's notorious for being an animal/The Croods flee after Grug is accused of robbing caves and stealing food for the Broods

programme.title: A Few Good Grugs / Valley Shine Day
programme.desc: The Valley has the first "try-all" against the Croods to see if Grug stole food for the Broods; Thunk asks Kevin to teach him to be more irresistible

programme.title: Breaking The Bank
programme.desc: Crispin Biscuits heists the underwater Baby Bank in an attempt to steal all the funds from Boss and Tina’s new company. Boss, Tina and Banker Baby Benny must infiltrate the bank via submarine to stop this high-stakes aquatic robbery. But Boss and Tina struggle to stay on the same page after Tina admits that she might, kinda, sorta be thinking about retiring as a regular baby.

programme.title: Hate That Baby!
programme.desc: After Crispin Biscuits changes the Baby Love economy to reward companies for bringing in baby hate, Boss Baby is forced to make himself the most hated baby in town to save their startup company. Meanwhile, Tina needs to end Crispin Biscuits’ attacks on their company before she can finally hang up her boss role and retire to a life of cuddle time with daddy and mommy.

programme.title: Total Nightmare
programme.desc: When Hookfang is drawn to a female Monstrous Nightmare, Snotlout tries to break them up before he loses his friend forever.

programme.title: Team Astrid
programme.desc: After Dagur attacks Berk, Astrid trauns a crew of back-up Dragon riders to battle back, although no one anticipates how soon the strike will come.

programme.title: Captain Underpants and the Troublesome Treachery of the Thieving Toot Fairy
programme.desc: George and Harold race against Mr. Krupp to try to get him fired before they get expelled

programme.title: Captain Underpants and the Tenuous Takedown of the Tyrannical Teachertrons
programme.desc: In the season opener, George and Harold have returned to school due to a technicality, but the school has been taken over by Melvin and a cyborg Melvin from the future! Their goal is to make the school extremely difficult by replacing all the teachers with Teachertron robots. Suffering under the new regime and without Mr. Krupp/Captain Underpants on hand to help, the boys hypnotize gym teacher Mr. Meaner and turn him into Sergeant Boxers to fight back.

programme.title: D'aja Vu
programme.desc: Stuck in a time-loop, Aja finds unlikely help from Jim Lake and Team Trollhunters. Meanwhile, a giant Troll rampages the Arcadia High Science Fair, threatening to expose both the Troll world and Aja and Krel’s alien secret.

programme.title: Flying the Coop
programme.desc: A menacing school board Administrator demands Aja and Krel's immigration papers to register for school - a task that turns dangerous for the two "illegal Aliens." Meanwhile, Aja bejins her warrior training with Vex

programme.title: Party Crashers
programme.desc: Aja attends her first teem party, Krel goes hunting for an urban legend with Eli, but the kids' fun is ruined when the Zeron Brotherhood crash their night. Meanwhile, Vex receives a message from Akiridion-5.

programme.title: The Stroll
programme.desc: Tina and Boss adjust to co-boss responsibilities while on a mission to rescue the baby with the best hair in the world from a lice outbreak. With opposing leadership views, the two split the existing field team's focus and discover a new archenemy in Lumpy the Park Duck.

programme.title: Potty Mouth
programme.desc: After a baby says a swear word on live television (censored by child-friendly online filter Sheriff Potty Pardner), Boss becomes obsessed with proving that the baby was taught this filth by their new arch-nemesis, Lumpy the Park Duck. Meanwhile, Tina's search to find what that swear word means creates unintentional havoc for both Tabitha's research paper and for Baby Corp's online systems when Sheriff Potty Pardner gives them an "internet time out"

programme.title: Imaginary Friends
programme.desc: After Boss insults Tina's imaginary friend, he's forced into "Imaginary Friend Sensitivity Training" at Baby Corp. Boss makes up his own imaginary friend to get out of these meetings, but after Tina gets a whiff that he may be lying, he's forced to keep up the charade at work and at home.

programme.title: The Knight's Fall - Part 1
programme.desc: Po and Blade rush to warn the Emperor about the weasels, but he has Po arrested and Colin captures Blade, revealing that she was never a knight. Thrown in a cell, Po reunites with Rukhmini and Mr. Ping, and he copes with the truth about Blade as they break out. Po fights Klaus and Veruca but is outmatched. Blade defeats Colin and hurries to help Po but is too late.

programme.title: The Knight's Fall - Part 2
programme.desc: Blade tells Po the truth about Alfie. The group chases after Klaus and Veruca in an epic snowy mountain chase, culminating in Po saving Blade’s life as the weasels take off with the gauntlet and the whip. Rukhmini reveals that she actually has the real whip in her staff, and she knows where to go to get the next one: India.

programme.title: The Liar and The Thief
programme.desc: The team arrives in India where an old friend of Rukhmini can supposedly give them a pendant that will lead to the next Tianshang weapon. But when they arrive, they find that Rukhmini’s hometown has changed a lot in the thirty years she’s been gone, and her old friend Diya might not be willing to help them.

programme.title: There Will Be Mud
programme.desc: Big Oil is bringing big improvements to the school. But new track stables, an upgraded veterinary lab and dorm rooms come at a cost - and spark disaster.

programme.title: Race To The Finish Part 1
programme.desc: The girls get summer jobs to help Lucky repair the sprawling house she inherited from her grandfather near the Rosemead Valley Racetrack.

programme.title: Race To The Finish Part 2
programme.desc: Determined to save her family home, Lucky signs up to race as a wild card in Rosemead's elite Junior Cup. But winning it all won't be easy.

programme.title: The Flawed Couple/ Go-Sip Girl
programme.desc: To learn about jobs, Grug assigns kids to the first "shadowing"/Ugga mistakenly creates the first gossip to impress the "nitting" club

programme.title: Munk History / Happy Howl Day

programme.title: Snooty And The Beasts Part 1 & 2
programme.desc: After rescuing Kevin and almost having a first kiss, Eep sets up dangerous situations to recreate the moment; Grug and Snoot go on a rescue/mission

programme.title: Gone Gustav Gone
programme.desc: When Dagur the Deranged captures Gustav, it's up to Hiccup, Toothless and the Dragon Riders to get him back.

programme.title: Reign Of Fireworms
programme.desc: Fireworms invade Dragon's Edge, while Ruffnut and Tuffnut discover that they have an unexpected connection to the island.

programme.title: Crushing It
programme.desc: As a Rumblehorn wreaks havoc on Dragon's Edge, Hiccup seeks the help of Stoick - who forms an unexpected bond with the rampaging beast.

programme.title: Hiss Hiss Bang Bang
programme.desc: Eager to return to normal life, Jim struggles with re-adjusting as he leads the Trollhunting team to track down three Goblins that escaped the Darklands

programme.title: Hero With A Thousand Faces
programme.desc: Jim tries to impress Claire's parents when invited over for BBQ, but when his Amulet goes haywire, Jim must contend with his own worst enemy - himself

programme.title: Just Add Water
programme.desc: The students are assigned to care for flour babies in Health Class but must worry more than just their grades after discovering a Gruesome lurking in Arcadia

programme.title: Captain Underpants and the Worrisome Wedge of the Water Warmongers
programme.desc: Harold and George can't wait to spend the summer together at camp. But not so fast, boys -- your old nemesis Mr. Krupp has a most unpleasant surprise.

programme.title: Captain Underpants and the Angry Abnormal Atrocities of the Astute Animal Agressors
programme.desc: Stuck in separate camps, Harold and George unleash a hyperintelligent talking possum to scare the pants off of Krupp. What could possibly go wrong?

programme.title: Captain Underpants and the Abysmal Altercation of the Abominable Altitooth
programme.desc: Eager to get the campers out of his hair, Krupp orders them to climb Plummet Peak, where a terrifying creature is rumored to reside.

programme.title: War of the Cheeks
programme.desc: Boss searches for evidence that Tabitha's best friend is an Uncuddleable, but is sidetracked by a Templeton Family tradition: "The War of the Cheeks", a Go Fish tournament where the winner gets to make family rules for a whole day. When Yvette joins in, Boss has to keep her from winning, out of fear that an evil babysitter will make family rules that overturn the Templeton household.

programme.title: Techy Tykes
programme.desc: Trying to win Tabitha's loyalty for Baby Corp, Boss and Tina invite her to Techy Tykes, a technology convention at their office. But when the top-secret UBO goes missing, the outsiders Tabitha and Tim (who's tagged along to relive his glory days) immediately become the number one suspects.

programme.title: Return To The Balmera
programme.desc: The Paladins attempt to liberate the inhabitants of the Balmera, but the arrival of a Galra battle cruiser puts the mission at risk.

programme.title: Rebirth
programme.desc: When a Galra monster descends upon the Balmera, Team Voltron must find a way to save the deteriorating living planet and its alien inhabitants

programme.title: Lucky And The Shaky Day
programme.desc: When an earthquake takes out the railroad bridge, the PALs must find a way to stop the oncoming train - which Jim is aboard

programme.title: Why Meerkat Is Always On The Look Out
programme.desc: You see there was a time when Meerkat was not always on the lookout. Meerkat used to race around Tinga Tinga bumping into things and causing chaos. She never stayed still long enough to listen to any beast. But then one day Meerkat bumps into the Sleeping Stones... and they make her listen alright! Tales from Africa.

programme.title: Why Cheetah Has Tears
programme.desc: You see there was a time when Cheetah didn't have tears. She was the fastest animal in the whole of Tinga Tinga. Cheetah was faster than even the Wind. Every year Cheetah and Wind would race to see who was the fastest and every year Cheetah would win. Until one day.... Tales from Africa.

programme.title: Big Chris Gets Lucky
programme.desc: Big Chris realises that he only ever has good luck when he has his lucky mascot with him. But what happens when he loses it on race day?

programme.title: Silver Hatch Fun Run
programme.desc: Roary and Plugger really want Big Chris to take part in the fun run but Big Chris isn't so sure. Can they make sure he trains for it without even realising?

programme.title: It's Go Go Go At Silver Hatch
programme.desc: Murray Walker is visiting Silver Hatch. Mr Carburettor would like him to commentate while the cars put on a stunt display. But Murray has other ideas… he admits he has always dreamed of racing himself. An unlikely candidate makes his dreams come true!

programme.title: Silver Hatch Heroes
programme.desc: Mr Carburettor's cousin Chubby is coming to Silver hatch as he wants to film his new blockbuster there. Everybody goes all out to prove that it is just the right location for Chubby's new film

programme.title: PC Roary
programme.desc: Roary helps PC Pete keep the track safe on a snowy day.

programme.title: Winter Breeze
programme.desc: Breeze is visiting the track. The beach is boring in the winter as nobody comes to visit. She tries her best to help everyone get ready for the winter festival but doesn't seem to be good at anything…

programme.title: Somewhere / Over the Rainbow
programme.desc: Kelp is swept by an ocean current to the shore of Unicorn Land where he sees a majestic creature on a cliff that looks just like him, but not like his Narwhal family under the sea. Kelp tells his family he’s a unicorn. / Kelp returns to Unicorn Land where he meets Pixie and Juniper, who show him around and introduce him to unicorn spark and magic.

programme.title: The Nest
programme.desc: When the Rescue Riders save Viking chief Duggard, they’re invited to visit his village of Huttsgalor, where they must prove they're kind and helpful.

programme.title: Night
programme.desc: The crew uses Lightning Bitbugs to light up the garage when Dozer needs a late-night repair, but need a new plan after Scrapadactyls attack.

programme.title: Rollodons
programme.desc: When tar fills the cracks of the crater, the Dinotrux must find a way to herd the free-roaming Rollodons to help smooth over the sticky situation.

programme.title: Untitled Templeton Project
programme.desc: Fired from Baby Corp and trying to build their own business, Boss Baby and Tina waste all their startup funds immediately, requiring a loan from Banker Baby Benny. In order to receive their seed money and get their company rolling, they have to rebuild the town’s faith in a baby who made everyone miss a huge sporting even (and they have to do it on a very limited budget)

programme.title: Puppy Love
programme.desc: Unable to land baby clients, Boss and Tina take in a naughty little puppy as a side hustle, trying to earn a little extra scrap. But once they discover the dogs in the neighborhood are stealing for a puppy trainer named Becker, the mission gets much bigger, and our team is forced to earn a little Puppy Love for once.

programme.title: Captain Underpants and the Troublesome Treachery of the Thieving Toot Fairy
programme.desc: George and Harold race against Mr. Krupp to try to get him fired before they get expelled

programme.title: Captain Underpants and the Tenuous Takedown of the Tyrannical Teachertrons
programme.desc: In the season opener, George and Harold have returned to school due to a technicality, but the school has been taken over by Melvin and a cyborg Melvin from the future! Their goal is to make the school extremely difficult by replacing all the teachers with Teachertron robots. Suffering under the new regime and without Mr. Krupp/Captain Underpants on hand to help, the boys hypnotize gym teacher Mr. Meaner and turn him into Sergeant Boxers to fight back.

programme.title: Thunk O'clock High / The Croo-Gitive
programme.desc: Thunk must face a bully that's notorious for being an animal/The Croods flee after Grug is accused of robbing caves and stealing food for the Broods

programme.title: A Few Good Grugs / Valley Shine Day
programme.desc: The Valley has the first "try-all" against the Croods to see if Grug stole food for the Broods; Thunk asks Kevin to teach him to be more irresistible

The crew decides to investigate and discovers a Cleve Kelso-controlled water facility that’s stealing water from the village. They manage to blow up the facility, but it alerts Rafaela and Matsuo to their whereabouts.

programme.title: The Hunt
programme.desc: In an awesome chase/battle through the desert, the crew goes up against Rafaela, Matsuo, and Sandocal - who are driving the kids’ own cars. The crew struggles to fight back while also not losing the trail to Cleve’s base in the desert. When Rafaela turns on Sandocal, he and Layla decide to work together and manage to overpower Rafaela and Matsuo. Sandocal tells the kids to go to escape toward the Bedouin Shield.

programme.title: The Bedouin Shield
programme.desc: It’s revealed that Cleve is building a massive weather machine that is generating dangerous desert storms, with the help of a genius North African teen named Ziri. When Cleve creates a sandstorm to take out the crew, they’re saved by two Bedouin brothers named Kareem and Salem (and their pack of camels). Echo questions her ability to be a good leader and if they should give up.

Prison Fighters
programme.desc: This series follows former Muay Thai champion Noy Khaopan and American Cody Moberly, two inmates in a Thailand prison, who after seven years are given the chance to fight for their release. By joining a controversial government modern day Prison Fight program, murderers and felons are given the chance to fight for their freedom, and possible redemption, through the ancient tradition of Muay Thai matches. Episode 3 of 4.

programme.title: FS MMA Nick Agallar vs. Nardu Debrah
programme.desc: BodogFIGHT features classic MMA matches involving some of your favorite fighters! Two Americans will engage in a lightweight battle for the next roster spot as Nardu Debrah of Brooklyn, NY and Nick Agallar of Milwaukee, WI square off in Costa Rica.

programme.title: MEGA Fights In 60 Edison Miranda vs. Willie Gibbs
programme.desc: MEGA Fights are premiere events from the sport of boxing including HBO World Championship Boxing and historic PPV events plus past, current and future World Champions. This episode features Super Middleweights Edison Miranda (26-2, 23 KOs) vs. Willie 'The Gladiator' Gibbs (20-1, 16 KOs) from the Miccosukee Indian Gaming Resort in Miami, Florida, USA. Bonus coverage includes Jason Litzau, aka 'The American Boy' (20-1, 18 KOs) vs. Jose Hernandez (21-3, 13 KOs).

programme.title: San Pedro Qualifying: Part 2
programme.desc: The qualifying rounds conclude at the Port of Los Angeles in San Pedro, Cal., before the historic battleship USS Iowa, where a very special all active duty and retired military members tackle such obstacles as the Log Runner and I Beam Cross.

programme.title: Ekaterinburg Grand Slam
programme.desc: Judo for the World features the best competitors in the sport as they compete in a global tour for an opportunity to vie for the gold in the World Judo Championship. In this episode we see the best of the Judo Grand Slam from Ekaterinburg, speak with number 1 ranked fighter Khasan Khalmurzaev about his return to Judo, and show Soichi Hashimoto's success using his signature throw.

programme.title: Biomechanics of Breaking
programme.desc: In this episode we focus on the martial art of breaking and how the techniques are fine-tuned with technology.

programme.title: KNOCKOUTS! Saul (Canelo) Alvarez vs. Jose Miguel Cotto
programme.desc: The main event in this episode is Saul (Canelo) Alvarez defending his NABF welterweight title against Jose Miguel Cotto, Alvarez's final bout before rising through the ranks and championships of the WBC. Also on the card, a heavyweight kickboxing clash between Errol Zimmerman vs. Rico Verhoeven.

programme.title: Tokyo, Japan: Show 1
programme.desc: For the first time the top ranked sumo competitors in the world are featured in an action packed series, FIGHT SPORTS GRAND SUMO. This new format presents Sumo in an authentic, in-depth and entertaining way covering the rules, ranks, match-ups, and more. Show 1 featuring Goeido, Ichinojo, Daieisho and Kotoeko from the Aki basho, 2019.

programme.title: Wide World of Fights Sergio Martinez vs. Matthew Macklin
programme.desc: This episode features an undisputed middleweight title fight between Sergio Martinez and Matthew Macklin, as well as kickboxing, sumo and more!

programme.title: Once Upon A Time In Shanghai
Once Upon A Time In Shanghai
大玩特玩[粤]
programme.desc: 主持在马湾寻十只贪玩野兽参与游戏。根据经验，特玩队一定输？杨潮凯认为与翟威廉同组才是真正原因！简单只用派对纸条响哨作游戏，当对手吹响声时用口一咬，阻止对方得分，陈嘉桓要投诉林希灵玩得太恐怖！经典「大电视」游戏出场，为何每条题目都是在形容翟威廉？何浩文见到甚么而变得木无表情？出线游戏「乒乓层层叠」，大玩队在两分钟内便完成，特玩队由威廉接最后一棒，单单是这一棒已花两分钟。看来潮凯的说法不幸言中。

programme.title: 香港早晨[粤] 及 交通消息[粤]
香港早晨[粤] 及 交通消息[粤]
香港早晨[粤] 及 交通消息[粤]
香港早晨[粤] 及 非法外围大追击2026[粤]
高朋满座#63[粤]
programme.desc: 朋坚持要送婷留学，婷绝食抗议，朋连厨艺也下降。家人推举悦解决此事，悦成功让婷在众人前签下「独立合约」，婷亦真的修心养性，朋亦动摇他要婷留学的决心。可惜，婷足球队的队友突然对她有求，令她被迫说谎。

programme.title: 尚食#3[粤/普]
programme.desc: 庖厨战战兢兢地给太子做菜，太子对菜式点头称赞；庖厨回去时，一帆检查太子吃剩的菜式是否有肉；紫萍担心自己冒名顶替会被锦衣卫发现；太子对汉王上书赈灾查证一事很气愤，瞻基提醒太子不要急于觐见，需要从长计议。

programme.title: 交易现场[粤] 及 潮流生活志[粤]
阿爷厨房[粤]
programme.desc: 「鼎爷」李家鼎再次开炉，奉上连串「消失的味道」。首集公开「古法阿爷虾抽」秘方，腌制前要烘熟虾只并剪开虾背，有助提升鲜味。用镬炮制烧肉方便快捷，要做出「荔枝皮」有何技巧？「镬底烧肉」配以虾抽一起享用，鲜甜香脆！鼎爷带拍档「阿谭」谭玉瑛到西瓜田，分享拣选「美人」的要诀。未熟的西瓜亦有用处？阿谭心急试吃「西瓜酸」，却瞬间变脸！鼎爷提醒烹调西瓜酸前须汆水减咸，再加糖调味，并带来惹味菜式「西瓜酸炒牛柳」。

programme.title: 流行都市[粤]
programme.desc: 急性喉炎常见于转季时，患者多会出现声沙、喉咙痛等症状。耳鼻喉专科医生提醒，婴幼儿因上呼吸道较狭窄，如出现呼吸困难或喘鸣声，应马上求医。急性喉炎亦可能引致扁桃腺炎等并发症，治疗详情如何？有设计师因疫情契机转型全职艺术家，可曾为生计忧心？他希望透过以马为主题的创作，展现自由、勇往直前的精神。他又细谈画马的难处，并述说创作平面画与立体画的差异。「睇𩠌食饭」环节，Annie师傅示范「萝卜饭照烧猪颈肉」。

programme.title: 一条麻甩在汕头[粤]
programme.desc: 上集于龙眼南路觅食，原来龙眼北路亦不乏非遗美食！祖蓝想开餐，要先执行任务？在食肆自家的农场先抓一只大鹅，祖蓝却称鹅只都与他差不多高，最终只好由老板代劳。精粹的卤水汁如何熬制？祖蓝亦亲身试试卤鹅过程，换来鹅肝、鹅肉、鹅肉丸等满桌美馔。接着到另一非遗食店，先帮手卖出三份肉丸才可品尝大大粒的墨鱼丸，店主还大方公开制作工序。饮啖茶，祖蓝巧遇国家一级潮剧演员，听他浅唱一曲后，祖蓝以京剧回馈对方，同样精彩。

programme.title: 灿烂的外母#15[粤]
programme.desc: 秀琼认为晓盈破坏司徒岚婚姻，对她恨之入骨。佩珊将晓盈传给威龙的短讯转发秀琼，让她知道百喜升注资鼎福和。秀琼指骂兆明与晓盈夹计吞并鼎福和，坚拒出售家业。窦彰知道司徒岚和兆明为鼎福和吵架，指兆明和秀琼都是为鼎福和好。司徒岚认为窦彰有自主权，窦彰恍然大悟。威龙带晓盈来帮佩珊修理水龙头，佩珊指自己未与威龙离婚，晓盈永远是小三。晓盈得悉邓勤已成功收购冷压果汁五成股权，故谎称鼎福和已落实出售三成股权……

programme.title: 偶像星愿7 Third BEAT![粤/日]
programme.desc: TRIGGER消失后，相关工作转发给其他偶像，当中不乏有违本身形象的角色。ZOOL上到《爱之Night》做嘉宾，言辞针锋相对，中途放弃表演，刻意制造麻烦。壮五表示想尝试为MEZZO"写歌，希望得到环和其他人的同意。

programme.title: Hands Up[粤]
programme.desc: 本集「Artspiration」，子健哥哥指导Emily姐姐绘画鲸鱼，再加上八爪鱼、水母、海星、珊瑚等海洋生物，以及不同鱼类，构成了一幅生动有趣的海底世界图画。香港向来有美食之都的美誉，食物种类繁多。这回「开心SHARE」以「我最爱的港式食物」为主题，孩子们投稿分享对咖喱鱼蛋、鸡蛋仔、鱼肉烧卖等的喜爱，也勾起主持姐姐对这些美食的滋味回忆，她们更谈到某次于Tiffany姐姐家中共聚BBQ的欢乐时光。

programme.title: 秘密的偶像公主[粤/日]
programme.desc: 在第四次偶像公主大赛中，阿纺展现出光芒四射的公主姿态，引起全城热话。在今天的特备节目中，美月向阳葵、Quartet STAR、千依等人进行采访，尝试找出阿纺那个姿态的原因，可是，阿纺的秘密仍然神秘莫测……
